I’m only considered decent because there is no one outstanding among my peers.
Compared to you, Vice Minister Gongsun, I can only say that I am passable.”
Although what Chen Mobai was most famous for was his swordsmanship talent, in actuality, his talent in this area could only be described as ordinary compared to farming, talismans, puppets, etc.
He now dared not approach the Great Dao Tree, as his Sword Dao Realm had been stagnant at “Sword Light Shapeshifting” for some time.
Fearing that Gongsun Jielu would ask him about Sword Dao, Chen Mobai promptly became humble.
Gongsun Jielu: “I heard from Zuo Gong that he passed the Sword Destruction Collection to you.”
Chen Mobai: “Back when I was at the Daoist Academy, True Person Zuo Gong took a liking to me and gave it to me along with the Sword Control Department’s textbooks.”
In reality, it was because Zuo Gong couldn’t teach Chen Mobai anymore, so he gave him his treasured Sword Destruction Collection, considering it as having given guidance.
Gongsun Jielu: “So have you accomplished anything with it?”
Chen Mobai: “Lacking resources, I’ve achieved nothing.”

The Sword Destruction Collection required Earthly Fiendish Qi, and although with Chen Mobai’s current status, procuring a bit of Five Elements Evil Qi wouldn’t be too conspicuous, he decided to shake his head anyway, out of caution.
After all, he now had the Purple Electric Sword, and the power of the Five Elements Sword Slaughter Formation wasn’t particularly important.

Within the Immortal Sect, with his and the Purple Electric Sword’s minds in harmony, others would only think his Sword Heart was extraordinary, his talent exceptional, and his match with the Sword Artifact incredibly close.
But Earthly Fiendish Qi, within the systems of Xianmen, still had the possibility of exposure.
Gongsun Jielu: “That’s quite a pity.
I heard from Zuo Gong that you mastered Sword Light Shapeshifting, capable of evolving the Five Elements Sword Light.
I thought that after Core Formation, you would collect the Five Elements Evil Qi first thing and cultivate the Five Elements Sword Sha.”
Hearing this, Chen Mobai chuckled dryly twice but did not continue the conversation.
In his mind, however, he wondered how Zuo Gong could not keep things to himself and had revealed his secrets.
“The Head of Immortal Affairs is getting old and is preparing to retire.
If Gongye Zhixu can’t achieve ‘Nascent Soul Formation,’ then the Righteous Law Hall Master would naturally replace him.”

Gongsun Jielu suddenly said something that caught Chen Mobai off guard, as he was interested in becoming the Sect Master but knew that there was no chance of getting involved in such high-level matters within the next hundred years.
Chen Mobai continued to stay silent, and Gongsun Jielu kept talking.

“In that case, the current Deputy Hall Master of the Dharma Hall, who is also the Enforcement Department Director, Narcissus, would naturally be promoted to become one of the Three Great Halls’ Righteous Law Hall Masters.”
“After Narcissus’ promotion, the competition for the Deputy Hall Master of the Dharma Hall would be between me and Wen Lianshan of the Sky-Mending Group.
However, the chances are high that I would get it, as the Sky-Mending Group has always worked behind the scenes and doesn’t have as good a reputation as me.”
“Another reason is that I’m more suited to cultivate the Immortal Sect Sword Art.”
Upon hearing this, Chen Mobai had a vague idea of why Gongsun Jielu was telling him all this, but he remained silent, pretending to be unaware.

“If I do become the Deputy Hall Master of the Righteous Law Hall, Wen Lianshan will likely transition from the shadows to a more public role and take up the position of Enforcement Department Director.
I would be glad to make this trade with him.”
“That would mean Lan Haitian would become the leader of the Sky-Mending Group, but the Enforcement Department would lack a vice director.
If you’re willing, I could arrange for you to join after this affair.”

“Later, with a little more experience and some achievements, with your cultivation level and support from both the Dance Instruments and Sky-Mending factions, as well as my backing, securing the position of vice director will be almost certain.”
After listening to all of Gongsun Jielu’s words, Chen Mobai was greatly tempted.
This could be said to be the most suitable official career path for him.
A high starting point in the Department of Law Enforcement with a clear promotional roadmap that was also highly achievable.
Becoming one of the Three Great Halls’ Masters was a childhood dream of his.
“After becoming vice director, with your stunning talent, you are bound to surpass Wen Lianshan and the others.
When you become deputy hall master, you can practice the top sword artifact of the Immortal Sect, which for a sword cultivator, is considered an unparalleled scripture.”
Gongsun Jielu, seeing Chen Mobai seemed moved, added more incentives, mentioning the Immortal Sect Sword Art that all sword cultivators aspired to.

In the past, Ancestor Baiguang was, while holding the position of Righteous Law Hall Master, enlightened by the Immortal Sect Sword Art, developing the Method of Entrusting the Primordial Spirit, embarking on the path to Divinity Transformation.
However, Gongsun Jielu’s words had the opposite effect.
Chen Mobai was very clear about his own swordsmanship talent.
Nowadays, within Xianmen, he was ranked alongside Ancestor Baiguang as having the Qualification of Deification, but this couldn’t be further from the truth.

chapters.title: Chapter 978 - 978 537 The Road to Heaven
paragraphs: “If I fail to grasp anything from the Immortal Sect Sword Art now, wouldn’t I be blatantly telling the world that I’m a fraud?”
Thinking about such a socially disastrous possibility, Chen Mobai felt it was safer to focus on obtaining resources and cultivating in the Tianhe Realm.
“Vice Minister Gongsun, I still prefer the way things are now, with no music to disturb my ears and no documents to tire my body, and it’s closer to home too,”
Chen Mobai tactfully declined Gongsun Jielu’s offer, and upon hearing this, she looked surprised.
Then she turned to look at Qing Women, seeming to remember something, and with a frown, she added another sentence.
“Her case is merely an exception; you needn’t worry that the upper echelons of the Immortal Sect are all like that.”
Upon hearing these words, Qing Women, who had been expressionless until then, suddenly became visibly moved. Her eyes became moist as she looked at Chen Mobai, touched.
She had thought that Chen Mobai was irritated by the upper echelons because of her and therefore had rejected this path leading straight to the heavens.
“I am simply following my own heart, not wanting to entangle my Sword Heart with mundane affairs—it has nothing to do with others.”
Before Qing Women could say anything, Chen Mobai interrupted firmly, not wanting her to misunderstand.
But his words seemed to have the opposite effect.
The tears Qing Women had been holding back couldn’t be restrained any longer and started streaming down her smooth, pale cheeks as she began to sob quietly.
Seeing this scene, Gongsun Jielu sighed.
No wonder he could resonate with Master Qingshi’s Purple Electric Sword Heart; he too was a man of deep emotion.
Thinking this, Gongsun Jielu did not say anything more and turned to leave.
Chen Mobai was left standing there somewhat stiffly.
He thought he had made himself clear, so why had Qing Women suddenly started to cry?
After hesitating for a long time, Chen Mobai took a pack of tissues out of his Golden Core Domain.
Just as he handed it to Qing Women, she threw herself into his arms and began to cry even harder.

Seeing that others nearby were turning their gazes towards them, Chen Mobai felt extremely awkward. He could only cast a Wooden House Talisman that enclosed both him and Qing Women, blocking them from the view of onlookers.
“Brother Chen, the formation is all set up, we’re ready to head up the mountain,”

It was about half an hour later when Lan Haitian’s voice came from outside the wooden house. Chen Mobai could only pat Qing Women on the back, who after sobbing for a while, had calmed down quite a bit, though she still felt somewhat ashamed and continued to shrink in Chen Mobai’s embrace.

Now that they were being prompted, Qing Women had no choice but to let go of Chen Mobai’s waist, her face flushed. She lowered her head, unconsciously twirling a strand of hair on the right side of her face.
“Stay here and wait in peace; we’ll take care of this matter quickly.”
Chen Mobai handed the tissues in his hand to Qing Women and then patted her head before getting up and leaving the wooden house.
“Fair winds on your journey.”

Qing Women’s soft words followed him as Chen Mobai, with his back to her, waved his right hand, then joined Lan Haitian and Gongsun Jielu outside, all of them transforming into beams of Escaping Light and flying towards the Cinnabarite Institute.
At the base of the mountain, Lan Haitian had already used a Magic Artifact to confirm the whereabouts of Yu Tianguang.
The three of them did not waste any time; they avoided the students and rushed straight to the mountaintop, to a stone house where the Spirit Vein was strongest.
“Who dares to be so impolite!”
As Chen Mobai and his two companions landed on the mountaintop, Yu Tianguang inside the stone house immediately sensed it. His displeased voice rang out.
With the stone door opening, he saw Chen Mobai at the entrance and frowned slightly.
“What are you doing here? You don’t even bring a basket of fruit when visiting me!”
Chen Mobai felt a bit awkward and pointed to the sides of the stone house with his hand.
Yu Tianguang stepped out of the stone door, glancing left and right, his face suddenly changing.
“Vice Minister Gongsun, Vice Chief Lan! What brings you two to my place today?”
Upon hearing this, Lan Haitian didn’t say much but directly took out an arrest warrant and sent it flying to Yu Tianguang with a puff of air.

“Pure nonsense. I’ve been a bona fide member of the Immortal Sect since birth and a graduate of the Dance Tool Dao Academy. Aren’t you afraid of being blamed by the principal and Ancestor Baiguang for slandering me as a cultist!”
Upon seeing the arrest warrant, Yu Tianguang’s face turned red with anger.
It seemed he really was being wronged.
Chen Mobai thought this, yet remained silent, simply watching how Lan Haitian and Gongsun Jielu interacted with Yu Tianguang.

“Originally, Master Chengxuan wanted to come in person to clean up the mess to avoid tarnishing the Dance Tool Dao Academy’s reputation because of you. However, the Immortal Sect decided to deal with this matter quietly, so they only called on nearby Councilor Chen to follow along.”
As Lan Haitian spoke, he pointed to the embarrassed-looking Chen Mobai.
“Chen kid, what exactly is going on here?”
Yu Tianguang immediately glared at Chen Mobai, shaking the arrest warrant in his hand excitedly. A flame of fury ignited in his eyes.
“True Person Yu, I am acting on the orders of the Kaiyuan Hall Council, cooperating with these two.”
Chen Mobai gently stated, expressing his stance.
But this very statement caused Yu Tianguang’s face to alternate between red and white.

Being the Dance Tool Dao Academy’s most outstanding graduate in recent centuries, Chen Mobai stood beside Lan Haitian, blocking Yu Tianguang’s way, and Yu Tianguang knew the academy had abandoned him.
“I am innocent. I want to see the principal. I want to see the masters of The Three Great Halls. I want to see Ancestor Baiguang...”

As a Cultivator who had grown up within the Immortal Sect, Yu Tianguang knew very well the Sect’s background and power. He intended to rely on his formidable strength to argue his case, but he didn’t dare to truly make a move.
In the end, all he could do was shout loudly to proclaim his innocence!
As the clicking sound rang out, Lan Haitian produced a pair of specially made handcuffs and approached Yu Tianguang.
“True Person Yu, your status as a Kaiyuan Hall councilor has not yet been revoked, and I do not wish to make this ugly...”
While speaking, Lan Haitian hinted for Yu Tianguang to give up resisting.
After hearing this, Yu Tianguang’s face turned crimson with rage, and the powerful Spiritual Power in his Dantian Qi Sea burst forth, as if he intended to resist.
However, Gongsun Jielu next to him drew a toothpick from his sleeve and flicked it lightly. A sharp, dark-green Sword Light burst out, instantly piercing into Yu Tianguang’s Gold Core.
In Chen Mobai’s shocked gaze, Yu Tianguang’s Spiritual Power dissipated entirely, seemingly retracting back into his Gold Core, nailed down and suppressed by that toothpick.

With a pfft, Yu Tianguang spat out a mouthful of fresh blood. The vast disparity in strength left him feeling utterly disheartened. Although he still had his Lifespan Artifact to activate, it would have been a futile effort against Gongsun Jielu, a Sword Dao grandmaster.
The arrest of Yu Tianguang went unexpectedly smoothly.
From beginning to end, Chen Mobai never lifted a finger, merely serving as a witness to Lan Haitian and Gongsun Jielu subduing Yu Tianguang.
“Chen kid, I’ve been wronged. You must tell the principal...”
As Yu Tianguang was being taken away by Lan Haitian, he lifted his head and said one last thing to Chen Mobai.
“Don’t worry, this incident won’t affect your record in the Immortal Sect, and might even be recorded as a merit.”
Gongsun Jielu walked up to Chen Mobai and struck up conversation again.

“Do you truly not want to join the Hall of Orthodox Law? Is it that you dislike the Department of Law Enforcement? What about the Sky-Mending Group and the Military Department, are you interested in those?”

The Hall of Orthodox Law controlled the two major martial forces inside and outside the Immortal Sect, with the Military Department being directly led by the Righteous Law Hall Master, while the Department of Law Enforcement was under the Vice Hall Master.
“No, I just want to live a simple life training with the sword and farming, and in my spare time, drawing talismans and making puppets.”
Chen Mobai’s demeanor, wanting a reclusive life, puzzled Gongsun Jielu.
“Don’t you want to undergo ‘Nascent Soul Formation’?”
“Can’t one undergo ‘Nascent Soul Formation’ without relying on the Immortal Sect?”
Chen Mobai retorted.

“Without the support of the Immortal Sect, you would need the resources of the Four Great Daoist Sects. But the Dance Tool Dao Academy’s Infant Forming Spirit Medicine has already been given to Duanmu Longrong; are you sure you want to wait three hundred years?”

chapters.title: Chapter 979 - 979 538 The Real Goal
paragraphs: Chen Mobai: “Does Nascent Soul Formation necessarily rely on external objects?”

Gongsun Jielu: “In the history of the Immortal Gate, Yuanyang Ancestor is the only one who formed a Nascent Soul without using Spiritual Objects. Even for him, he needed the Portal to send him to the Taiyin Star so that his Gold Core could break open and birth the Nascent Soul.”
Chen Mobai: “But aren’t there also cultivators of the Lasting Spring Cultivation technique?”

Gongsun Jielu: “Even those who have perfected the Lasting Spring Cultivation technique would not reject Infant Forming Spirit Medicine, because there are some barriers that one could not get past without consuming Elixirs, no matter how many times one tries.”
After hearing this, Chen Mobai had a look of realization. It was the first time he knew about these things.
Then he smiled slightly and said something that left Gongsun Jielu stunned in place.
“Then, I will try to be the first one.”
What first one?
To form a Nascent Soul purely by oneself, without relying on external objects!?
Has he gone mad?

Does he think he is Yuanyang Ancestor? That’s an Innate Pure Yang Body, cultivated into an Immortal Spirit Root with an Immortal Technique of Patching Heaven—the most defiant talent, whose foundation was so profound and talent so extraordinary, he was indisputably the first person of the Immortal Gate, unparalleled in ancient and modern times!

Although you are regarded as having the Qualification of Deification, compared with Yuanyang Ancestor, you are far from being on the same level... Eh... this guy in front of me... seems... looks like...
At this point, Gongsun Jielu suddenly remembered that Chen Mobai was cultivating the Pure Yang Scroll, which had been revised by Yuanyang Ancestor.
If he really cultivated the Pure Yang Daoist Body to Perfection, it was possible for him to refine his talents into a half Yuanyang Ancestor.
That would be the cultivation of an Acquired Pure Yang Body, not as good as the Innate.
But even so, it was still an incredible talent.
In that case...
His statement doesn’t seem so preposterous after all!
After realizing this, Gongsun Jielu started looking at Chen Mobai differently.
This guy, could he actually manage to form a Nascent Soul on his own?
Thinking this, Gongsun Jielu felt like the Immortal Gate was of no use to him anymore.
Qualification of Deification, terrifying indeed!
For the first time in his life, Gongsun Jielu, who had always prided himself on his extraordinary talent, felt jealous and envious of the talent of a younger person.
With this, the good mood he had for making an arrest and gaining merit had mostly dissipated.
Chen Mobai watched as Gongsun Jielu walked forward in silence and couldn’t help scratching his head, feeling that the statement he had just made was perhaps a bit too bold.
But that’s always been his role in the Immortal Gate!
As he was about to leave, Chen Mobai suddenly remembered something, and his expression changed slightly.
Wait, didn’t Master Xin Ji say that there is a wicked person reincarnated from the Ascension Sect in the Red Sandstone City?
Yu Tianguang was easily subdued by Gongsun Jielu, so obviously, it wasn’t him.
If Yu Tianguang wasn’t the one, then why, when he, the remnant of the Ascension Sect, was taken away, had the wicked person not yet made a move?
Does that indicate...
As Chen Mobai thought about it, he felt more and more likely that Yu Tianguang had been wronged.
But even thinking this way, there was no way he could help clear Yu Tianguang’s name, as the Immortal Gate does respect evidence.

When Chen Mobai followed Gongsun Jielu back to the base of the mountain, Lin Yin was already directing members of the Sky-Mending Group who had come to dismantle the Formation they had previously set up.
Lan Haitian, holding a handcuff chain, with the other end connected to Yu Tianguang’s handcuffs, was responsible for the close custody before he was escorted to Wangwu Cave Heaven.
After all, Yu Tianguang’s identity was not ordinary, and he would need to go through a complete trial process before his guilt could be established.
When Chen Mobai returned, he felt as if a gaze from a hidden place glanced at him.
However, upon looking around, he found nothing.
Chen Mobai hesitated but still decided to sit down next to Yu Tianguang and Lan Haitian.
“His Gold Core has been pinned down by Deputy Minister Gongsun, rendering him unable to use his Spiritual Power. I alone can guard him,”
Lan Haitian thought Chen Mobai was deeply afraid that Yu Tianguang might escape and bring shame to the Dance Tool Dao Academy, and said with a laugh.
“No matter the outcome of the trial, True Person Yu has been kind to me, and I will escort him along the way so that he will not suffer.”
Chen Mobai chose to follow his own heart, making this choice.
At these words, Yu Tianguang, who had been closing his eyes, suddenly opened them wide, gave Chen Mobai a deep look, seemed like he wanted to say something but then sighed and lowered his head.
“If that’s the case, then I’ll trouble Brother Chen to keep me company on this journey,”
Lan Haitian didn’t refuse and invited Chen Mobai to sit down with a smile.
Because they hadn’t anticipated that the arrest would go so smoothly, they still needed to wait a while for the Immortal Gate’s flying vessel to come.
“I have always been curious. What kind of evidence was it that allowed the Hall of Orthodox Law to act so decisively, even to the point of involving me in the arrest of True Person Yu?”
After harboring doubts, Chen Mobai found the process of having Yu Tianguang identified as a remnant of the Ascension Sect a bit problematic.

Within the Immortal Gate, to convict a councilor of the Kaiyuan Hall, an official notice had to be issued by the Kaiyuan Hall first, stripping him of his councilorship, and then the Hall of Orthodox Law could move in to arrest.

There had been instances where Kaiyuan Hall councilors had been arrested directly, but those were during urgent war times or when the Huashen Ancestor gave the direct order. In times of peace like now, Chen Mobai had never heard of bypassing protocol and acting directly like this.
“Brother Chen, before we came here, we suddenly received a mysterious slip of paper.”

Lan Haitian, instead of answering directly, mentioned something that made Chen Mobai’s heart skip a beat. However, he kept his expression unchanged and pretended to be surprised as he inquired, “What slip of paper?”

This guy, could he actually manage to form a Nascent Soul on his own?
Thinking this, Gongsun Jielu felt like the Immortal Gate was of no use to him anymore.
Qualification of Deification, terrifying indeed!
For the first time in his life, Gongsun Jielu, who had always prided himself on his extraordinary talent, felt jealous and envious of the talent of a younger person.
With this, the good mood he had for making an arrest and gaining merit had mostly dissipated.
Chen Mobai watched as Gongsun Jielu walked forward in silence and couldn’t help scratching his head, feeling that the statement he had just made was perhaps a bit too bold.
But that’s always been his role in the Immortal Gate!
As he was about to leave, Chen Mobai suddenly remembered something, and his expression changed slightly.
Wait, didn’t Master Xin Ji say that there is a wicked person reincarnated from the Ascension Sect in the Red Sandstone City?
Yu Tianguang was easily subdued by Gongsun Jielu, so obviously, it wasn’t him.
If Yu Tianguang wasn’t the one, then why, when he, the remnant of the Ascension Sect, was taken away, had the wicked person not yet made a move?
Does that indicate...
As Chen Mobai thought about it, he felt more and more likely that Yu Tianguang had been wronged.
But even thinking this way, there was no way he could help clear Yu Tianguang’s name, as the Immortal Gate does respect evidence.

When Chen Mobai followed Gongsun Jielu back to the base of the mountain, Lin Yin was already directing members of the Sky-Mending Group who had come to dismantle the Formation they had previously set up.
Lan Haitian, holding a handcuff chain, with the other end connected to Yu Tianguang’s handcuffs, was responsible for the close custody before he was escorted to Wangwu Cave Heaven.
After all, Yu Tianguang’s identity was not ordinary, and he would need to go through a complete trial process before his guilt could be established.
When Chen Mobai returned, he felt as if a gaze from a hidden place glanced at him.
However, upon looking around, he found nothing.
Chen Mobai hesitated but still decided to sit down next to Yu Tianguang and Lan Haitian.
“His Gold Core has been pinned down by Deputy Minister Gongsun, rendering him unable to use his Spiritual Power.
I alone can guard him,”
Lan Haitian thought Chen Mobai was deeply afraid that Yu Tianguang might escape and bring shame to the Dance Tool Dao Academy, and said with a laugh.
“No matter the outcome of the trial, True Person Yu has been kind to me, and I will escort him along the way so that he will not suffer.”
Chen Mobai chose to follow his own heart, making this choice.
At these words, Yu Tianguang, who had been closing his eyes, suddenly opened them wide, gave Chen Mobai a deep look, seemed like he wanted to say something but then sighed and lowered his head.
“If that’s the case, then I’ll trouble Brother Chen to keep me company on this journey,”
Lan Haitian didn’t refuse and invited Chen Mobai to sit down with a smile.
Because they hadn’t anticipated that the arrest would go so smoothly, they still needed to wait a while for the Immortal Gate’s flying vessel to come.
“I have always been curious.
What kind of evidence was it that allowed the Hall of Orthodox Law to act so decisively, even to the point of involving me in the arrest of True Person Yu?”
After harboring doubts, Chen Mobai found the process of having Yu Tianguang identified as a remnant of the Ascension Sect a bit problematic.

Within the Immortal Gate, to convict a councilor of the Kaiyuan Hall, an official notice had to be issued by the Kaiyuan Hall first, stripping him of his councilorship, and then the Hall of Orthodox Law could move in to arrest.
There had been instances where Kaiyuan Hall councilors had been arrested directly, but those were during urgent war times or when the Huashen Ancestor gave the direct order.
In times of peace like now, Chen Mobai had never heard of bypassing protocol and acting directly like this.
“Brother Chen, before we came here, we suddenly received a mysterious slip of paper.”
Lan Haitian, instead of answering directly, mentioned something that made Chen Mobai’s heart skip a beat.
However, he kept his expression unchanged and pretended to be surprised as he inquired, “What slip of paper?”

chapters.title: Chapter 980 - 980 538 The Real Target
paragraphs: “I still have it saved; take a look, Brother Chen.”
Lan Haitian handed over the sentence cobbled together using the characters from the newspaper, and when Chen Mobai picked it up, a look of “shock” appeared on his face.
“Yu True Person doesn’t look like it.”
After pondering, Chen Mobai spoke those words, then handed the sentence back.
However, when Lan Haitian took it back, he performed an action that astonished Chen Mobai greatly.
“Yu True Person, please take a look as well.”

Yu Tianguang had always been curious, but thinking he was wronged and wanting to behave properly, he deliberately closed his eyes when Lan Haitian presented the paper, as a gesture to show he wouldn’t peek.
But now that Lan Haitian personally asked him to look, Yu Tianguang opened his eyes.
Upon reading, his expression underwent a drastic change!

“It wasn’t me! If it were me, I would have definitely suppressed the three of you on the spot, not put up with this nonsense. Plus, after entering Wangwu Cave Heaven, under the watch of two at Divinity Transformation, I would have had no chance to escape, so why would I have surrendered without a fight?”

Yu Tianguang’s words garnered Chen Mobai’s full agreement; if he were reincarnated as an evildoer from the Ascension Sect, he surely would have tried to break free from the Immortal Gate’s shackles and flee Di Yuan Star the moment he was exposed.

“Twenty-three years ago, I carried out a mission in Red Sandstone City. During that incident, I worked with Brother Chen to slay all the Ascension Sect’s heretics, but the target we needed to protect was taken away by a mysterious Golden Core Master...”
Lan Haitian recounted an old case.
“It couldn’t have been me.”
After listening, Yu Tianguang uttered five words, but he lacked sufficient evidence to prove his innocence.
“After our investigation, not a single Golden Core Master from the Immortal Gate was in Red Sandstone City at that time, so the suspect had to be a local resident.”
“What about Shi Qing! Why are you so sure it’s me?” Yu Tianguang blurted out immediately upon hearing Lan Haitian’s words.
“Yes, there’s also True Person Shi Qing!”
Lan Haitian simply smiled and clapped his hands, causing Chen Mobai to furrow his brows at this gesture.

“Last month, Gu Changfeng who was incarcerated for practicing a Forbidden Technique suddenly confessed, claiming he copied the Devour God Technique for you and that you also cultivated this Forbidden Technique.”
“Impossible, I swear I haven’t cultivated the Devour God Technique!”
Yu Tianguang spoke, about to raise his hand and swear an oath of his Dao Heart.

“Yu True Person, wait a moment. Gu Changfeng has also sworn a Dao Heart oath stating definitively that you have cultivated the Devour God Technique. The Mind-reading Talisman of the Hall of Orthodox Law ensures he has not lied.”
Lan Haitian stopped Yu Tianguang from making an oath and spoke words that left Yu Tianguang with a stunned gaze.
“What in the world is going on? I really haven’t cultivated the Devour God Technique...”
By the time he said this, Yu Tianguang no longer had the same confidence.
Because if Gu Changfeng has survived the Dao Heart oath and the Mind-reading Talisman, it means he has told the truth.
Yet Yu Tianguang was certain that his own memory contained no trace of any cultivation of the Devour God Technique!
“Brother Chen, what do you think?”

At this moment, Lan Haitian suddenly addressed Chen Mobai, who after some thought, offered a response, “Is there a possibility that Yu True Person, without his knowledge, cultivated some Art of Divine Consciousness, believing it to be a normal technique of the Immortal Gate, but it turned out to be a Forbidden Technique?”
Clap clap!
After Chen Mobai finished speaking, Lan Haitian suddenly burst into applause, nodding at Chen Mobai with a greatly surprised expression.
“Correct, that is also a possibility we deduced. So the question arises, which Art of Divine Consciousness that Yu True Person cultivated could be the Devour God Technique?”

As soon as Lan Haitian’s words ended, Yu Tianguang immediately started to recall, listing the names of all the books he had read related to Divine Consciousness from his Qi Cultivation Seventh Layer days onward.
“Volcano Meditation Technique,” “Morning Sun Technique,” “Divine Control Technique,” “Azure Jadeite Charm,” “Rising Sun Mind Movement Method”...
When Chen Mobai heard of the Divine Manipulation Technique, his heart skipped a beat.
“The ‘Morning Sun Technique’ and the ‘Divine Manipulation Technique’ are two modified directions of the Devour God Technique, it couldn’t possibly be these two, could it?”
After recounting all the contents related to divine consciousness from his memory, Yu Tianguang somewhat uncertainly said.
“Can True Person Yu recite the contents of these cultivation techniques from your memory?”
Lan Haitian asked again, and Yu Tianguang immediately nodded.
Lin Yin promptly took out paper and pen while also moving a table over.
Humming!

Just at that moment, the flying ship prepared by the Hall of Orthodox Law arrived in the airspace above them. Since the primary target had been arrested, there was no need to disguise the tremendous disturbance.
Soon, people from the Cinnabarite Institute noticed the enormous object that had appeared in the sky.

Two Foundation Establishment teachers came over immediately, Lin Yin went up and gave a brief explanation. They also saw Yu Tianguang being pressed in between Lan Haitian and Chen Mobai, their expressions changing drastically before they returned the way they had come.
“The show is nearly over, it’s time to take True Person Yu away.”

Seeing this scene, Lan Haitian, carrying Yu Tianguang, ascended toward the flying ship in mid-air, while Chen Mobai, observing this, employed his spiritual power to support the table with the paper and pen and followed them up.
Yu Tianguang, now unable to mobilize his spiritual power, showed gratitude towards Chen Mobai upon seeing this.
Before long, Lin Yin and the rest of the Sky-Mending Group who set up the large formation also entered the flying ship.

However, Chen Mobai did not see Gongsun Jielu, a hint of inspiration fleetingly crossing his mind. Combining what Lan Haitian had said earlier, he felt he might have grasped the true purpose of this operation.
It was at that moment that the flying ship started to glow with spiritual light, then turned around and headed towards the Wangwu Cave Heaven.
The speed wasn’t very fast, as if it was deliberately waiting for someone.
But to Lan Haitian’s disappointment, even after flying out of Red Sandstone City’s airspace, he had not waited for that person.
“The one you want to capture isn’t True Person Yu, is it? You just want to use True Person Yu to lure out the real target!”
Chen Mobai asked. Lan Haitian listened, slightly surprised, then nodded lightly.
By that time, Yu Tianguang had already silently transcribed all the contents. Lan Haitian picked them up for a look and singled out the “Azure Jadeite Charm”.

“This Cultivation Technique is only available up to the third layer of Gold Core in the Immortal Gate’s library, yet True Person Yu’s version can be practiced up to the ninth level of Golden Core. Where did it come from?”

“True Person Shi Qing taught it to me, saying she had perceived the continuation of this technique that directly points to Nascent Soul while cultivating with Biyu Wutong through Spirit Transformation.”

“She herself used it to clear all obstacles to the ninth level of Golden Core but has not yet achieved ‘Nascent Soul Formation’, so she only passed on to me the part concerning divine consciousness up to Golden Core Perfection.”

“Practiced within the range of Red Sandstone City’s Spiritual Vein, this technique allows you to contemplate the Biyu Wutong at the Spiritual Vein Core. The improvement of divine consciousness with this contemplation becomes twice as effective. The closer you are to the Biyu Wutong, the faster the progress of divine consciousness, and even your thoughts become clearer and swifter.”
“I truly did not know that this was the Devour God Technique!”
By the end of his confession, Yu Tianguang had grasped the truth, glaring at the transcription of the “Azure Jadeite Charm” he had written down, wishing he could tear it apart right there.
“Did Vice Minister Gongsun go to capture Shi Qing?”
Chen Mobai also realized, at that moment, that the Immortal Gate had long known that Shi Qing was the one practicing the Devour God Technique.
The sudden and open arrest of Yu Tianguang this time and deliberately letting the people of the Cinnabarite Institute know when leaving was probably to draw out Shi Qing.

“The people of the Cinnabarite Institute must have reported our capture of True Person Yu to True Person Shi Qing. Logically, with such an incident occurring within her territory, she must come out to inquire after knowing about it.”

“According to our original plan, as long as True Person Shi Qing leaves the Biyu Wutong to intercept us, the Forbidden Array on this flying ship would be activated, severing her connection with the Biyu Wutong, and then the higher-ups would take action to suppress her.”
“But since she didn’t come as planned, we’ll have to initiate the alternative plan B!”
By this time, Lan Haitian was no longer keeping secrets.

chapters.title: Chapter 981 - 981 539 Master Huakai
paragraphs: “What is Plan B?”
Chen Mobai asked.
Lan Haitian smiled, not saying a word but instead walked to the edge of the airship and opened the shielded window’s panel.
Then, a brilliant azure spiritual light like the clear sky entered Chen Mobai’s eyes.

The blue light surged like tidal waves, like an ocean, forming into the shadow of a gigantic shark which opened its gaping maw as if a rift into a dark void had torn through the heavens, abruptly descending.

In Chen Mobai’s shocked and incredulous eyes, the symbol of Red Sandstone City, the towering Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree emitting steam and fog, was devoured whole, from top to bottom, by the immense phantom shark.

“Once the Narcissus Venerable’s Beiming Domain is deployed, it can sever the flow of spiritual mechanisms within and without. In the past, our Daoist Academy’s Spiritual Venerable used this to deal with the Changchun Ancestor of the Jumang Academy,” Lan Haitian explained as he gestured Lin Yin to stop the airship, turning towards Red Dawn Institution not far away.
Chen Mobai followed him to the window of the airship, looking at the massive yawning jaw of the shark occupying half the sky, murmuring to himself:
“Deputy Hall Master of the Hall of Orthodox Law, Enforcement Department Director, Sea Goddess... I didn’t expect her to take action!”
Among the fourteen Nascent Souls of Xianmen, three were not in human form, and the one with the greatest background was this Narcissus Venerable.

She was a disciple of the Spiritual Venerable, who presided over the vast Four Seas. After her Transformation, she entered the Kunpeng Daoist Institute to cultivate and quickly succeeded in “Nascent Soul Formation” by studying the Six Dominions Scripture.
She was also the only Yuan Ying level Deputy Hall Master among the Three Great Halls of Xianmen.
As Gongye Zhixu and Ye Yun’e toiled away, waiting for the Infant Forming Spirit Medicine, Narcissus had already directly become the first successor to the Three Great Hall Masters.
Should any of the Three Great Hall Masters step down, she would be next in line to take over.
The Sea Goddess was the title bestowed upon Narcissus when she first joined the Kunpeng Daoist Academy by the other students.
In such a resource-scarce environment of Xianmen, as a disciple of the Spiritual Venerable, she was arguably the wealthiest among the fourteen Nascent Souls.
Because the Spiritual Venerable had granted her clan a Sea Territory within Di Yuan Star as their fiefdom.
It’s said that there, an innumerable count of spiritual pearls and shellfish thrives, with the full pearls brimming with spiritual energy, rivaling even top-grade Spirit Stones.

“Once the Beiming Domain isolates the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree, all we need to do is arrest Shi Qing,” said Lan Haitian, as a dark green sword light had already shot up from the highest peak of the Danxia Mountain Range, after the loss of the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree.
It was Gongsun Jielu!
Chen Mobai, having felt her power when she suppressed Yu Tianguang, recognized her at once.
The sword light soared like a dragon, extending in the void with ease, instantly enveloping a lithe figure in a purple gown within it.
Chen Mobai pushed his Void Spirit Eye to its limits and finally caught sight of Shi Qing, the unanointed monarch who had presided over Red Sandstone City for over a hundred years.
She was an ordinary-looking woman, but her eyes shimmered with a strange iridescence. Her expression was stern, her snow-white hand holding a crimson Stone Flower.
With each wave of the Stone Flower, a ring of torches blossomed as if they were shockwaves, sweeping away the encircling dark green sword light that Gongsun Jielu had sent from all directions.

“Shi Qing had already reached the Ninth Level of Golden Core decades ago, and with the aid of the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree and the Fire Vein of this city, she was in complete harmony with them. Although Vice Director Gongsun’s cultivation level is extraordinary, ranking among the four great Sword Dao masters of Xianmen, facing Shi Qing who has the geographical advantage, the outcome is uncertain,” Yu Tianguang stated, coming over with a worried look on his face.

“That’s exactly why the Narcissus Venerable personally took action,” said Lan Haitian, not the least bit worried. At that moment, a strand of blue light lit up atop the massive shark in the sky that had devoured the Biyu Wutong Tree, and a girl with white hair and eyebrows, as pure and white as jade, floated out.
With a flick of her finger towards Shi Qing, a stream of water sharp as a laser pierced through Shi Qing’s Spiritual Force Shield in an instant, penetrating into the Qi Sea of her Dantian.

Is this the power of a Xianmen Nascent Soul? Chen Mobai marveled upon seeing the Narcissus Venerable suppress the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree and then with a single move, overpower Shi Qing, who was at the Ninth Layer of Golden Core.
Zhou Shengqing, who had used the Reverse Longevity Technique, was not nearly so fierce.

“Is this... over?” Yu Tianguang, witnessing this scene, couldn’t help but widen his eyes. He had never imagined that the Narcissus Venerable could subdue the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree and still have a clone to subdue Shi Qing.
“Of course, the gap between Golden Core and Nascent Soul is just so,” Lan Haitian said, his face showing a rare pride.
The Narcissus Venerable was a graduate of their Kunpeng Daoist Institute, and her easy victory in this battle demonstrated their institute’s status as the number one of Xianmen’s Daoist Academies.

Even though during the eras of Chen Mobai and Zhongli Tianyu, the Dance Tool Dao Academy had unexpectedly taken the top seat, it was still their Kunpeng Daoist Institute that held the position as the foremost Daoist Academy in Xianmen.

“Now that Shi Qing has also been arrested, you can release me. If you wanted to use me to lure her out, why didn’t you notify me first? Would I have disagreed?” Yu Tianguang started to complain, raising his still handcuffed hands in displeasure.
“I’m sorry, True Person Yu, but you have, after all, practiced the Devour God Technique; even unconsciously, you need to be treated as a suspect,” Lan Haitian replied.

With each wave of the Stone Flower, a ring of torches blossomed as if they were shockwaves, sweeping away the encircling dark green sword light that Gongsun Jielu had sent from all directions.
“Shi Qing had already reached the Ninth Level of Golden Core decades ago, and with the aid of the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree and the Fire Vein of this city, she was in complete harmony with them.

Although Vice Director Gongsun’s cultivation level is extraordinary, ranking among the four great Sword Dao masters of Xianmen, facing Shi Qing who has the geographical advantage, the outcome is uncertain,” Yu Tianguang stated, coming over with a worried look on his face.
“That’s exactly why the Narcissus Venerable personally took action,” said Lan Haitian, not the least bit worried.

At that moment, a strand of blue light lit up atop the massive shark in the sky that had devoured the Biyu Wutong Tree, and a girl with white hair and eyebrows, as pure and white as jade, floated out.
With a flick of her finger towards Shi Qing, a stream of water sharp as a laser pierced through Shi Qing’s Spiritual Force Shield in an instant, penetrating into the Qi Sea of her Dantian.
Is this the power of a Xianmen Nascent Soul?
Chen Mobai marveled upon seeing the Narcissus Venerable suppress the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree and then with a single move, overpower Shi Qing, who was at the Ninth Layer of Golden Core.
Zhou Shengqing, who had used the Reverse Longevity Technique, was not nearly so fierce.
“Is this... over?” Yu Tianguang, witnessing this scene, couldn’t help but widen his eyes.
He had never imagined that the Narcissus Venerable could subdue the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree and still have a clone to subdue Shi Qing.
“Of course, the gap between Golden Core and Nascent Soul is just so,” Lan Haitian said, his face showing a rare pride.
The Narcissus Venerable was a graduate of their Kunpeng Daoist Institute, and her easy victory in this battle demonstrated their institute’s status as the number one of Xianmen’s Daoist Academies.

Even though during the eras of Chen Mobai and Zhongli Tianyu, the Dance Tool Dao Academy had unexpectedly taken the top seat, it was still their Kunpeng Daoist Institute that held the position as the foremost Daoist Academy in Xianmen.
“Now that Shi Qing has also been arrested, you can release me.
If you wanted to use me to lure her out, why didn’t you notify me first?
Would I have disagreed?” Yu Tianguang started to complain, raising his still handcuffed hands in displeasure.
“I’m sorry, True Person Yu, but you have, after all, practiced the Devour God Technique; even unconsciously, you need to be treated as a suspect,” Lan Haitian replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 982 - 982 539 Master Huakai
paragraphs: Lan Haitian felt a tinge of regret as he shook the bracelet connected to his wrist, for even now, he had yet to remove the restrictions placed upon Yu Tianguang.
“This has already proven that I’ve been wronged. To treat me this way, isn’t it a bit inappropriate!”
When Yu Tianguang said this, there was a hint of emotion in his voice.
Mainly because the extreme fright and joy of this night had pushed this seasoned Golden Core Master to a point where he could scarcely endure.
Seeing that Lan Haitian still refused to release him, Yu Tianguang’s eyes flashed with anger, turning toward Chen Mobai.
“True Person Yu, as long as you have been wronged, once we are at Wangwu Cave Heaven, the Daoist Academy will naturally help you clear your name.”
Chen Mobai preemptively interrupted Yu Tianguang’s words, but at that moment, he felt something odd.
Yu Tianguang’s emotions were inexplicably becoming overexcited.

But just then, the previously enraged Yu Tianguang suddenly became calm. With his head bowed, he offered a sinister smile and made a comment that caused Lan Haitian and Chen Mobai’s pupils to constrict.
[“Little devils of Immortal Gate, you are unexpectedly cautious!”]
Sizzle sizzle sizzle!
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!

Chen Mobai and Lan Haitian acted simultaneously, transforming Yi Wood Divine Thunder and Yin Yang Yuan Magnet Force into a stream of azure and a stream of gray, pressing down on Yu Tianguang’s Sea of Knowledge at the Purple Mansion and Dantian Qi Sea at the same time!
A silver torch appeared out of nowhere in front of Yu Tianguang, as if connected to a mysterious void. A vague figure holding a colorful treasure tree emerged within the torch.
With a swing of the treasure tree in his hand, he deflected the attack from Chen Mobai and Lan Haitian, protecting Yu Tianguang.

If not for the fact that both Chen Mobai and Lan Haitian had perfect control over their lightning and Yuan Magnet Force, they might have been turned into a shower of fragments by the flying boat in that moment.
“Divine Control Pavilion Master!”
Recognizing such an iconic entrance, Lan Haitian retracted the Yuan Magnet Force and his expression turned grave.
He raised his hand and fully triggered the power of the bracelet on his wrist. A swath of pitch-black luminescence flared up, swiftly spreading toward Yu Tianguang at the far end.
The binding artifacts of the Sky-Mending Group always had a safeguard, permitted to be used in extreme measures when the situation was unfavorable.
But the Divine Control Pavilion Master had already reached through the void, extending his right hand and that colorful treasure tree and lightly brushed over Yu Tianguang’s hands.
Crack!
The Third Rank Superior Grade handcuffs binding Yu Tianguang shattered in an instant, breaking into pieces and scattering on the ground.
[“I’ve nurtured this God Seed for quite a long time; it’s truly a pity to use it like this.”]
After freeing himself from the shackles, Yu Tianguang slowly raised his head, but his tone and expression had completely changed.
A silver flame symbol blazed on his forehead, and his eyes revealed a never-before-seen malevolence.
But amidst the malevolence, there was struggle, anger, pain, fear, and various other emotions.
“Who are you... how is this possible... I am a disciple of Immortal Gate... I can’t be your God Seed... act quickly... kill me...”
By the end of his plea, Yu Tianguang had already grabbed his own throat, intending to end his life while asking Chen Mobai and Lan Haitian to take action.
Lan Haitian didn’t hesitate at all and directly retrieved a magic artifact from his Domain. It was a stone with a mix of silver and black, vaguely divided into Yin and Yang.
It was the Star Concentrating Stone he originally obtained in the Dance Tool Dao Academy, which Lan Haitian had crafted into his Lifespan Artifact after his Core Formation.

He opened his right hand slightly, and the Star Concentrating Stone burst forth with pitch-black radiance, heavily slamming into Yu Tianguang, who was struggling against the Divine Control Pavilion Master for control of his body.

The hilt of the Purple Electric Sword dropped from the Domain; Chen Mobai reached out hesitantly, wondering whether to draw the sword, when he saw Lan Haitian catch the rebounding Star Concentrating Stone with both hands and was sent flying back, impacting the aft cabin wall of the flying boat.
After flinging Lan Haitian away, another phantom flew out of the true body of the Divine Control Pavilion Master who stood behind the torch.

This phantom, holding the colorful treasure tree, stepped out of the torch, descended upon the territory of Immortal Gate, and then directly merged into Yu Tianguang’s Sea of Knowledge at the Purple Mansion.
“It’s been perhaps three hundred years since I last came here.”
After completely occupying Yu Tianguang’s body, Shenyu Xuanzhu raised his palm to extinguish the torch and breathed in the fresh air of Di Yuan Star with a hint of intoxication.
Boom!
What met him head-on was a column of azure lightning.

The Shenyu Xuanzhu, who had just refined the God Seed, waved the rainbow-colored treasure tree in his hand in surprise. However, the Magic Artifact seemed to awaken its own will, trembling as it broke free from his grasp. It then burst through the airship’s window and headed straight for Shi Qing at the peak of Danxia Mountain.
With a snap, Chen Mobai’s Yi Wood Divine Thunder hit Shenyu Xuanzhu’s face without any resistance.
Taken off guard, Shenyu Xuanzhu was blasted away, just like Lan Haitian a moment ago.
With a thunderous crash, the airship could no longer hold together and disintegrated completely.

Fortunately, those on board were Foundation Establishment Practitioners, all capable of self-preservation. Chen Mobai flung out the Six Yang Divine Fire Mirror, using the Magic Artifact to shield them from the aftermath and safely bringing them to ground.
A spiritual light flared, landing beside Chen Mobai.
“Thanks.”
Lan Haitian floated beside Chen Mobai, wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth, and expressed gratitude to the latter for protecting the Sky-Mending Group aboard the airship.
“I was mainly saving Qing Nu.”
Chen Mobai maintained his persona, but Lan Haitian took it as pride and nodded his head in acknowledgment.
“Tch, and to think I nurtured you for three hundred years!”

At that moment, Shenyu Xuanzhu, who had been blasted away by the Yi Wood Divine Thunder, halted his momentum. Annoyed, he said, raising his slightly charred face and looking toward Shi Qing, who was now wielding immense power with the rainbow-colored treasure tree, fiercely battling with Narcissus and Gongsun Jielu at Danxia’s summit.

Shenyu Xuanzhu closed his eyes, feeling Yu Tianguang’s Spiritual Power, then opened them, his whole body erupting into torrents of spiritual flames, transforming into a crimson fireball and flying towards the highest peak of the Danxia Mountain Range.
“Stop him, the Shenyu Xuanzhu after catalyzing the God Seed and borrowing a body is at his weakest because he can only use the power of Yu Tianguang.”

As Lan Haitian spoke, he held the Star Concentrating Stone in the palm of his hand. With flickers of dark Yuan Magnetic Force, iron needles as thick as fingers and as long as half an arm with sharp ends emerged from the Void out of nowhere, bristling with a fierce cold light and intercepting the path of Shenyu Xuanzhu.

The golden-red flames, pushed to the extreme by the Scorching Heaven Cultivation technique, allowed Shenyu Xuanzhu, who surpassed the Gold Core Realm, to effortlessly melt the iron needles into molten metal, equivalent to the peak of Gold Core existence.
The Yi Wood Divine Thunder conjured by Chen Mobai was also blocked by the Scorching Heaven Light Shield.
Amidst his hearty laughter, Shenyu Xuanzhu breezed through the mountain of needles and the sea of thunder, easily landing in the midst of the battle at Danxia’s tallest peak.

The white-haired and white-browed Narcissus, upon seeing Yu Tianguang, roughly understood the situation. She frowned slightly and tilted her head to examine the rainbow-colored treasure tree in Shi Qing’s hands, her face revealing a moment of realization.
“So, it’s you. Three hundred years ago, you were shattered by the Kaiyuan Hall Master, your Taoist Body in tatters and your divine spirit scattered. I had thought you were already dead.”
At this time, Chen Mobai and Lan Haitian also arrived there, just in time to hear these words.
Who was the Narcissus talking about?
Chen Mobai glanced at Lan Haitian beside him, who silently transmitted four words.
Master Huakai!
This name Chen Mobai had heard of—the Master Huakai was one of the three Vice Sect Hierarchs of the Ascension Sect, as renowned as Shenyu Xuanzhu and the Hall Master of the Shrine of Life and Death.
Shi Qing was her reincarnated form!
“Can Narcissus fight against both of them?”
Chen Mobai asked Lan Haitian with some anxiety, who shook his head, showing disbelief, yet he had a face full of confidence and certainty.
“The Leading Star Ancestor’s Lifespan Artifact is linked with the Heavenly Curtain. As soon as Shenyu Xuanzhu breaks into Di Yuan Star, the Heavenly Curtain will sense it.”
“Once the Heavenly Curtain senses it, it means that the Leading Star Ancestor knows as well.”

chapters.title: Chapter 983 - 983 540
paragraphs: “When can Leading Star Ancestor arrive?”
Chen Mobai asked again, but Lan Haitian, who usually had an answer for everything, hesitated this time.
“The Five Peaks Immortal Mountains are half an Immortal Sect Domain away from here, which is quite a distance. The Ancestor might need some time.”
When Leading Star Ancestor last made a move, Lan Haitian had not yet been born, so he knew nothing about the Ancestor’s speed.

Moreover, within the Immortal Sect, details about the Huashen Ancestor’s strength had always been the highest-level secret. Even someone with Lan Haitian’s status had never accessed any related information.
“So, as it stands, we must rely on Master Narcissus.”

After Chen Mobai finished this sentence, he glanced at the battle situation at the highest peak of the Danxia Mountain Range. His innate combat instinct made him start to analyze the situation coolly and involuntarily.
On their side, there were four people: Master Narcissus, Gongsun Jielu, Lan Haitian, and himself.

On the opposite side were two evil powerhouses from the Ascension Sect; whether it was Shenyu Xuanzhu or Master Huakai, if they were to enter the fray in their peak true forms, both were no weaker than Master Narcissus.

Fortunately, Master Huakai hasn’t re-cultivated to the Nascent Soul Realm after being reincarnated through dissolution, likely to avoid drawing the attention of the upper echelons of the Immortal Sect.
And Shenyu Xuanzhu just catalyzed a God Seed and took over Yu Tianguang’s body to enter the battle.
The strength either of them could exhibit wouldn’t be too off the charts.
As long as Master Narcissus could perform normally...
Just as Chen Mobai was thinking this, Master Huakai suddenly swung the colorful treasure tree in her hand towards the massive shark phantom in the sky.
The treasure tree glittered like a rainbow and in an instant traced an arc of light, plunging straight into the Beiming Domain.
Amidst the booming sounds!

Chen Mobai felt the entire Danxia Mountain Range begin to shake, and Master Narcissus also frowned slightly, saying to the three of them, “While I’m suppressing the Biyu Wutong Tree, the Spirit Veins of Red Sandstone City are also being influenced by this Spirit Tree, resisting and trying to break free from my Beiming Domain.”

At this moment, Master Huakai was continuously swinging the colorful treasure tree in her hand, linking the vast Spirit Veins of Red Sandstone City with beams of rainbow light in a combined assault with the Biyu Wutong Tree from both inside and out.
The massive shark phantom actually revealed a rift.

Through the rift, one could clearly see the Biyu Wutong Tree with bark as green as jade and leaves as fine as flowers, continuously emitting clouds and fog, drawing in a vast Spiritual Machine, trying to break through the Beiming Domain trapping it.

“Without this Biyu Wutong and the Spirit Veins of Danxia pinning me down, I could take down these two alone,” Master Narcissus couldn’t help but spit out a breath, then her body radiated vast and profound Spiritual Power, transforming into a deep blue Spiritual Light that surged into the large shark phantom in the sky, reinforcing the power of the Beiming Domain.
“Master, is there anything we can help you with?”
“Will Leading Star Ancestor come?”
Upon hearing this, Chen Mobai and Lan Haitian asked different questions.
Master Narcissus: “Leading Star Uncle is a homebody who dislikes going out. He doesn’t consider the situation here a big deal and might not intervene.”
This statement left Chen Mobai and the others exchanging glances.
“What should we do?”
Across from them were two Vice Sect Hierarchs of the Ascension Sect, both of Nascent Soul Level.

“I’ll use the Six Imperial Swords Sha Formation to hold one of them at bay,” said Gongsun Jielu when the situation got to this point. She threw off her green suit jacket and rolled up the sleeves of her dress shirt, revealing six Sword Killing Sword Marks on her arms and hands.
The Sword Sha was a mysterious blue, snakelike, and dragonlike.

The dragon’s head was on the left hand, the tail on the right hand, and its body passed through her upper back. Although the white dress shirt covered it, once the Sword Sha marks lit up, Chen Mobai could still see them clearly.

“Why are you all so worried? I have a sky-reaching method to suppress the cultists,” Master Narcissus said, showing no concern. As the Righteous Law Hall Master and one of the top three in combat experience among the fourteen Nascent Souls of the Immortal Sect, she was well-versed in magical duels.
As she spoke, she pulled out a white jade bracelet, emitting an aura so peculiar that even Chen Mobai felt uncomfortable.
“The three of you, listen up...” Master Narcissus transmitted her voice into the minds of Chen Mobai and the others, sharing her full strategy in the span of a mere thought.
“Can it be done?”

After revealing her battle plans, Master Narcissus looked toward Master Huakai, who was continuously swinging the colorful treasure tree in the half-sky, and Shenyu Xuanzhu, standing beside her resolutely.
Gongsun Jielu: “We will do our best.”
Lan Haitian: “Even at the cost of my life, I will delay her.”
Chen Mobai merely nodded without speaking.

Master Narcissus didn’t care about his silence. After all, although Chen Mobai was regarded as having the qualifications for Divinity Transformation, he had just achieved Core Formation, and his combat power was certainly the lowest of the three.

“Before I devour Shenyu Xuanzhu, make sure you aren’t eaten by Master Huakai first,” Master Narcissus said, her mouth wide open, revealing two canine teeth, and showing to the two from the Ascension Sect in the sky an instinctively cruel smile.
“If possible, could you spare Yu Tianguang’s life?”
Chen Mobai hesitated but ultimately followed his conscience and requested this from Master Narcissus.

After all, although Chen Mobai was regarded as having the qualifications for Divinity Transformation, he had just achieved Core Formation, and his combat power was certainly the lowest of the three.

“Before I devour Shenyu Xuanzhu, make sure you aren’t eaten by Master Huakai first,” Master Narcissus said, her mouth wide open, revealing two canine teeth, and showing to the two from the Ascension Sect in the sky an instinctively cruel smile.
“If possible, could you spare Yu Tianguang’s life?”
Chen Mobai hesitated but ultimately followed his conscience and requested this from Master Narcissus.

chapters.title: Chapter 984 - 984 540 Reversing Qiankun
paragraphs: _2 The Narcissus simply gave him a strange glance and did not respond. She tightly closed her eyes and executed a powerful technique of the Kunpeng Daoist Institute.
“Close Eyes for Night!”
In that instant, darkness fell upon the sky!

In mid-air, as the Master Huakai and the Shenyu Xuanzhu who were causing rifts in the sharks’ shadows that emerged from Beiming Domain by leveraging the power of the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree, witnessed this turn of events, their attention was naturally drawn.
“Zulong Divine Eye Technique!”

The Ancient Evil Path Union had been competing with the Immortal Gate for thousands of years, and they were familiar with the significant techniques of both sides. Seeing the Narcissus close her eyes turning day into night, they recalled this top-tier Art of Spiritual Eyes from the Immortal Gate.
But what use would it be in this current situation?

The Shenyu Xuanzhu was a contemplative person. Seeing this, he began to ponder what exactly the Immortal Gate side was planning to do. He didn’t believe that with the Narcissus’s realm, she would engage in pointless actions.
“In the darkness, would the power of the Azure Jadeite Sycamore weaken?”

The Shenyu Xuanzhu asked Master Huakai this, who was beside him. She shook her head indifferently, uninterested in such matters. She simply shook the seven-colored treasure tree she was holding, driving this magic artifact, which was the culmination of all her power in her past life, aiming to coax the Azure Jadeite Sycamore through the Domain to complete her thorough rebirth!

The Azure Jadeite Sycamore in Red Sandstone City was a Fourth Grade Superior Spirit Plant. Under the meticulous care of Master Huakai, it had already shown signs of evolving into a fifth-order Spirit Plant.

According to her plan, all she needed to do was wait for her reincarnated body to break through to the Nascent Soul Realm. Then she could use the Forbidden Technique of the Flower Bloom Courtyard to deplete the Spirit Vein of Red Sandstone City completely, using all the Spirit Plant’s power to produce a fifth-order, nine-colored Immortal Flower!

This flower would contain all the essence of the Azure Jadeite Sycamore from over four thousand years. Furthermore, under the Forbidden Technique of the Flower Bloom Courtyard, it would filter out impure consciousness such as the vastness of the earth and the changes of mountains and rivers, leaving only the most pure and extreme vitality and Elemental Energy.

Once ingested by Master Huakai, she would not only instantaneously merge the powers of her past life and present life, reaching the Nascent Soul Peak realm, but could also comprehend the profound mystery of a Spirit Plant’s ascension to the fifth order through the experience.

With her profound cultivation, perhaps she could seize this opportunity to transform from Nascent Soul to Divine Spirit, setting foot at the peak of cultivation within the Immortal Gate with this reincarnated body of Shi Qing!
Unfortunately, even the best disguise was eventually exposed.

Shi Qing could roughly guess when her cover was blown. If only she had known, she would have intervened to stop that man, even if it meant the death of the cultivators with Dark and Wind Spiritual Roots at the hands of the Immortal Gate, rather than startling the enemy into awareness.
Regretting this, Shi Qing couldn’t help but feel bitter resentment.
When Kong Feichen took Yang Jing away, as the Vice Sect Hierarch of the Ascension Sect, she must have been aware of it.
The Shenyu Xuanzhu had also communicated with her in advance before sending people.
As the members of the Sky-Mending Group, such as Lan Haitian, arrived, she had been covertly monitoring the situation.
In her view, Kong Feichen and Yang Jing combined were less important than a single fingertip of hers. It didn’t matter whether their mission was successful or failed.
The key was to avoid exposing her true identity.
However...
Master Huakai thought of that person who made the final move to help Kong Feichen escape with Yang Jing, frowning deeply.
But at this stage in the game, the most important thing was to forcibly catalyze the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree before the experts of the Immortal Gate arrived.
Even if she was unable to produce a fifth-order nine-colored Immortal Flower, she had to leave Di Yuan Star before the arrival of the Divinity Transformation.
With this thought in mind, Master Huakai hesitated no longer, and pushed the power of the seven-colored treasure tree in her hands to the limit.

A brilliant splendor, never seen before, shone from her hands—it was as if she summoned a rainbow bridge from both ends of the sky, with one end in her hands and the other ending within the huge shark’s head that loomed faintly in the darkness.
This strike seemed to trigger a qualitative change!
With a loud bang!

The Beiming Domain could no longer sustain itself. The massive shark began to split from the head, spreading to the sides, and the top of the Azure Jadeite Sycamore first emerged through the crevices...

“By uniting with the Forbidden Technique and the Azure Jadeite Sycamore, I can harness the power of this Fourth Grade Superior Spirit Plant. The entire Spirit Vein of Red Sandstone City can be at my disposal, and even suppressing the Narcissus will be within reach!”

Seeing the Azure Jadeite Sycamore break free from the Beiming Domain, Master Huakai spoke confidently. She waved the seven-colored treasure tree and motioned for the Shenyu Xuanzhu to protect her as they flew towards the Sycamore Tree.
“Let’s take action!”
But at this moment, the Narcissus Superior suddenly spoke, her jade-white bracelet suddenly turned pitch black, a terrifying force capable of reversing Yin and Yang spread out.
Caught off guard by both Shenyu Xuanzhu and Master Huakai, this black deluge spread, submerging the skies above Danxia Mountain Range, enveloping all of them within.
Chen Mobai only felt a flash of darkness and light before his eyes, and the sky had cleared up once again.
However, looking down, he saw the surging sea below, dotted with scattered islets, like stars.
This was within the Beiming Domain!
They had been transported inside by the Narcissus Superior.
Besides them, there was another who had been transported in, and that was Master Huakai!

Her face full of astonishment, she waved the multicolored treasure tree in her hand, attempting to call upon the power of the Azure Jadeite Sycamore to break the barrier of the domain, but her current realm was only at the Ninth Level of Golden Core, and the difficulty of breaking the domain from the inside was many times greater than from the outside.
“Damn beast, I underestimated her!”
Immediately, Master Huakai also realized she had been fooled by the Narcissus Superior and lost her composure, cursing out loud.
Had she merged with the Azure Jadeite Sycamore, she was confident she could have overpowered the Narcissus.
But at the critical moment, the Narcissus used the magic artifact to reverse the Beiming Domain, released the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree, and trapped her inside.
Moreover, she separated Shenyu Xuanzhu from her.
This way, outside the Beiming Domain, the Narcissus would be alone facing the rampaging Azure Jadeite Sycamore and Shenyu Xuanzhu.

But without Master Huakai’s control, the Azure Jadeite Sycamore posed little threat to the Narcissus, and since Shenyu Xuanzhu was currently present through a borrowed body, he probably wouldn’t last many moves against the true Nascent Soul Superior, the Narcissus.
“The Spirit Plant can be made to destroy the Spirit Vein of Danxia City, causing a massive explosion that could break through Beiming Domain from the outside.”

However, Master Huakai, being a seasoned cultist with rich experience in magic duels, immediately moved to wield the multicolored treasure tree to cast a forbidden technique, but a dark green sword light, like a dragon, slashed towards her head in an instant.
Gongsun Jielu’s hands were marked with dark sword scars like ink dragons swelling, opening their dragon maws wide, biting towards Master Huakai’s head.
But the multicolored treasure tree flickered and blocked the dark green sword light.
Hum hum hum!
Sss sss sss!
Following Gongsun Jielu, Lan Haitian and Chen Mobai also made their move simultaneously.
Facing a heretical cult demon, naturally they would join forces, striking decisively and ruthlessly!

But at this time, Master Huakai showed the essence of her higher realm. She lifted the Lifespan Artifact Stone Flower she had refined in this world, its blossoming flame brilliance like a Red Lotus, extinguishing the Flying Needles and lightning coming at her from all directions.
Only Gongsun Jielu’s dark green Sword Sha managed to penetrate the barrier of the Stone Flower Red Lotus and slash towards Master Huakai.
However, facing the multicolored treasure tree, the Sword Sha softened and became powerless, dissipating into smoke.
But Chen Mobai saw this scene and his eyes lit up.

All they needed to do was delay Master Huakai here, and the Narcissus Superior outside would guarantee that within at most five minutes, she could suppress Shenyu Xuanzhu who had arrived through a borrowed body!
“You little devils, since you seek death yourself, you can’t blame me!”
Clearly, Master Huakai had also thought of this, and she had to invoke the power of the Azure Jadeite Sycamore to possibly break through the domain and escape Di Yuan Star.
With this thought, a fierce light flashed in her eyes, and she took the multicolored treasure tree in her hands and plunged it fiercely into her own chest.
In an instant, the roots of the treasure tree turned bright red.
Drops of Essence Blood were drawn, spreading along the withered branches, throughout the tree.
The originally multicolored radiance gradually began to shine with an eighth color!

chapters.title: Chapter 985 - 985 541 Aurora Starfall Talisman
paragraphs: The eighth color lit up, and instantly merged and devoured the other seven colors, then transformed into a dim and profound shade of gray-green that spread into the sky and in all directions.

Before the shocked gazes of Chen Mobai and the others, the precious tree that had been planted in the Master Huakai’s heart suddenly seemed to have gone through hundreds of years of time, abruptly growing into a large tree with withered branches yet full of vividly colored flowers.
After the tree expanded, its roots, like tentacles, entwined and enveloped Master Huakai’s closed-eyed body, layer by layer covering and protecting it.
Then, a blue flower fell from the tree amidst a sky full of Spiritual Light, transforming into a blue-skinned Master Huakai appearing before the three of them, including Chen Mobai.
But that wasn’t all; at the same time, three more flowers of different colors fell.
Afterward, four Master Huakais with the same countenance and stature, but different skin colors, stood in four directions around the tree.

“Being able to use this move to bestow death upon you is indeed your great fortune across three lives,” said all four Master Huakais at once. Then, aside from the first blue-skinned one, the other three Master Huakais—yellow, orange, and blue—flashed with sinister Spiritual Light and charged toward Chen Mobai and the group.
Amidst the clanging of metal,
Gongsun Jielu was the first to meet the charge, with her Sword Sha now fully bursting forth.

Dark sword marks swirling around, her right hand rejuvenated, transformed into a pitch-black evil dragon. With a mighty charge, its mouth opened wide to a 180-degree angle, biting and shattering the head of the yellow-skinned Master Huakai.
Gongsun Jielu’s eyes gleamed as she wielded her Art of the Spirit Eyes to pierce through the vision of the Master Huakai protected by the roots, cocooned within the tree.

With her right hand formed like a sword, her Sword Sha completely revived, seeming as if half her body had turned into a pitch-black evil dragon. She bypassed the yellow-skinned Master Huakai and charged straight for the tree.
Among the whooshing sounds, strands of withered yellow vines materialized out of nowhere in mid-air, forming a net in the sky that blocked the pitch-black dragon that was Gongsun Jielu.
“Such trivial obstacles...”
Gongsun Jielu slashed swiftly with her hand, her dark Sword Light flashing like a dragon, cleaving the air like a dark crescent moon, and slicing the myriad vines in two.
After cutting through the vines, the Sword Light continued its swift rush towards the tree.
But at that moment, Gongsun Jielu felt a sudden numbness in her right hand. Frowning, she ignored it and, turning into a dragon, charged right up to the tree.

Following that, a dark yellow, withered light appeared on the right side of Gongsun Jielu’s body. A tender sprout burst from her shoulder, and in the blink of an eye, blossomed into a small yellow flower.
Gongsun Jielu’s eyes opened wide, her left hand rose, and she directly chopped off her right shoulder, where the small yellow flower with a piece of flesh had grown.
Among the splattering blood, the small yellow flower suddenly transformed into the head of the yellow Master Huakai that she had devoured with her Sword Sha.
The yellow Master Huakai let out a sinister laugh, opened her mouth, and from it a petal flew towards Gongsun Jielu.

Meanwhile, not far away, the headless corpse whose head had been shattered by the Sword Sha flew over. Its arms transformed into vine-like whips, each bearing sharp barbs that shone with a cold light, sweeping towards Gongsun Jielu’s back.
Amidst the clashing sounds!
Sword-like dark lights suddenly pierced from Gongsun Jielu’s back, forming wing-like sword shields in an instant, blocking the vine whips.
The massive impact drove her even closer to the head’s flying petals.

However, this was her intention. With the momentum of the impact, Gongsun Jielu spread her right hand, and a cold, sinister sword tip of intermingled shades of black and gray burst from her palm. As it pierced through the flying petal, it also penetrated the forehead of the freshly reformed head.
With a loud bang!
The Master Huakai planning to regenerate was shocked to find a terrifying Sword Intent flooding into the flower clone’s Sea of Knowledge at the Purple Mansion; it then burst into a flurry of petals.
After destroying the head, the Six Imperial Swords Sha Formation in Gongsun Jielu’s palm suddenly retracted and disappeared, traveling up her arm to the dark sword wings on her back.
Then, with a slight unfurling of her sword wings, she also ground the headless flower clone attempting to escape behind her into bits.
“She’s using this cloning technique to hold us off while her real consciousness connects with the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree in Red Sandstone City. We can’t give her the time!”

Determined to end the battle swiftly, Gongsun Jielu, after dealing with her flower clone, spared not a glance for Chen Mobai and Lan Haitian. She immediately turned back into a dragon, roaring as she swept towards the true body of Master Huakai at the base of the tree.
In that moment, Gongsun Jielu had evolved her Six Imperial Swords Sha Formation into its most potent Sword Array.

Six different black evil dragons emerged from her body. In mid-air, they opened their jaws in unison to roar, with six streams of pure Sword Light emerging from their mouths. With the palm of Gongsun Jielu’s right hand as the center, it gathered into a deep night Sword Intent, as if it could drown all the light in the world.
With a thunderous roar!

Gongsun Jielu’s Six Imperial Swords Sha Formation struck the tree. The withered branches began to shake uncontrollably and split open with a deep crack, through which one could faintly see the true body of Master Huakai inside, and even trickles of blood seeping out through the crevice.
