chapters.title: Chapter 986 - 986 541 Aurora Starfall Talisman
paragraphs: _2 Clearly, the true body of Master Huakai, who was protected in the deepest place, had been injured!
Seeing this scene, Gongsun Jielu felt a surge of excitement and was about to deploy his Swords Slaughter Formation again when a paralyzing sensation suddenly flooded his body.
He widened his eyes in disbelief and looked down.
Tender shoots had, unbeknownst to him, sprouted all over his body, followed by the blooming of little yellow flowers.

Each little yellow flower transformed into the face of Master Huakai, with a cold expression. In an instant, they fully blossomed, starting from the back of his right hand and quickly engulfing Gongsun Jielu’s entire body.
A yellow flower cocoon then emerged in mid-air.

A withered branch extended from the treasure tree above, burrowing into the cocoon, and like a blood-drawing tube, it extracted strands of vivid red from inside the cocoon, injecting them into Master Huakai’s body deep within the treasure tree.
“This isn’t good, this guy has actually been tricked.”
When Chen Mobai saw Gongsun Jielu sealed in the flower cocoon, he couldn’t help but frown slightly; their mission was just to hold off Master Huakai.

Therefore, facing the flower clones rushing towards him, he simply activated the full defense capabilities of the Six Yang Divine Fire Mirror. Under the guidance of his Divine Sense, the golden Mysterious Yang Divine Light blocked the water swords, water knives, water crossbows, and other such techniques coming from all directions.
The flower clones that Master Huakai had dispatched were obviously well considered.
The blue-skinned flower clone that targeted Chen Mobai was able to manipulate water attribute spiritual power.

If it hadn’t been for the fact that the vast ocean environment of the Beiming Domain was still under the control of Narcissus, preventing Master Huakai from borrowing even a trace of the water elemental energy, perhaps Chen Mobai wouldn’t have been able to respond so easily with just the Six Yang Divine Fire Mirror.
By comparison, Lan Haitian’s approach was somewhere between Chen Mobai and Gongsun Jielu, advancing step by step towards the treasure tree while maintaining a strong defense.
Loud, explosive ‘bangs’ rang out not far away.

The orange flower clone seemed to be manipulating Earth-Fire Duality Attribute elemental energy. Every petal that flew out was like a Divine Thunder Bomb, repelled by the magnetic field, and when they hit the ocean’s surface, they triggered huge tidal shockwaves.
Lan Haitian was using his Star Concentrating Stone, and he had already invoked the Yin Yang Yuan Magnetism force of the Liu Yu Scripture.

Streams of starlight transformed into a magnetic field, merging with his domain to form an impenetrable realm, blocking the attacks of the orange Master Huakai outside, and he moved slowly but firmly towards the treasure tree.
“How can this guy turn his domain into a realm at such a level? Is it the characteristics of the Liu Yu Scripture, or is it because he opened his domain during Foundation Establishment?”
Chen Mobai was slightly surprised by the way Lan Haitian countered the orange-skinned Master Huakai clone.

“Brother Chen, Deputy Commander Gongsun is now in crisis. I will deploy a Fourth Order Starfall Aurora Talisman, but this talisman will be aimed at the true body of Master Huakai inside the treasure tree. By then, please assist in rescuing Deputy Commander Gongsun.”

The voice transmission from Lan Haitian suddenly resonated in Chen Mobai’s ears. Both of them had witnessed Gongsun Jielu’s condition, and as a member of the Immortal Gate, naturally, if they could save him, they would.
“Leave it to me!”

Chen Mobai, still a principled disciple of the Immortal Gate at heart, did not hesitate upon hearing this and reached into the void to grasp, and a long sword artifact, radiant with purple light, dropped out of thin air accompanied by sizzling sounds, and a surge of Lingxiao Sword Intent exploded from him as the center!
“This is... Unity of Man and Sword, Clear Heart of Sword!”
Lan Haitian’s eyes widened at this sight.
The Fourth Grade Superior Purple Electric Sword had completely submitted to the control of Chen Mobai who had just achieved Core Formation?
His swordsmanship talent was indeed rare in the world.
Among those of the same realm, only Ancestor Baiguang could be mentioned in the same breath.
He truly possessed the Qualification of Deification!
Lan Haitian, who had been quite worried, felt his confidence surge after witnessing the aura unleashed by Chen Mobai and the Purple Electric Sword.
He didn’t hesitate any longer, bringing out the Aurora Starfall Talisman he had specially requested for this mission!
A Fourth Order Talisman, each requiring registration and record-keeping within the Immortal Gate.
And the Sky-Mending Group, due to the special nature of their mission, could apply for Fourth Order talismans specifically for combat, powerful enough to reduce half of Danxia City to ruins.
Lan Haitian extracted a talisman from his domain, with black paper as the base, silver threads and patterns, the length of a small forearm, and the width of five fingers.
The moment spiritual power was injected, three lines of password locks suddenly flashed on the talisman paper.
“Spiritual Power Verification Passed!”
“Divine Sense Verification Passed!”
“Please Enter the Activation Password!”
Lan Haitian’s right eye brightened, and as he entered the password, the blocks were unlocked one by one!

After all three layers of passwords on the talisman were verified, the fourth-order talisman instantly transformed into a pale silver-blue light curtain that spanned across the skies and the ocean of the Beiming Domain.
In an instant, the light curtain condensed into a brilliant trail of starlight, as if a piece of the starry sky had fallen, heavily landing on the treasure tree.

It seemed that the treasure tree sensed the danger. Dozens of blossoms on its withered branches burst open at that moment, turning into a sea of flowers in an attempt to catch the descending aurora starfall!
The two fourth-order forces collided, and the sea of flowers exploded with great force.
The aurora starfall smashed onto the treasure tree!
Amidst the crackling sounds,
the withered branches of the treasure tree snapped one after another, breaking from the middle, revealing the true body of Flower Bloom Courtyard’s master hidden deep within.

At this life and death juncture, she could only open her eyes, filled with an extremely cold glint. Suddenly, a void opened in the palm of her hand, and one could vaguely see the landscape of the Danxia Mountain Range beyond the domain.
After being summoned by her, a branch as thick as an arm violently passed through the spatial rift and extended inside, colliding with the aurora starfall plummeting from the sky.
Meanwhile, Chen Mobai had already cut off the connection between the chrysalis and the treasure tree before this.
He wanted to uncover the sealed treasure, but remembering the scene of Gongsun Jielu covered in daffodils, he stopped himself from contacting the daffodils to avoid meeting the same fate.
Boom!

At that moment, the two earth-shattering forces collided and burst forth fully, and Chen Mobai immediately activated the Six Yang Divine Fire Mirror to form a hemispherical shield, protecting both himself and the chrysalis.
A familiar figure was sent flying back.
It was Lan Haitian, who appeared to have severely damaged his vital energy while activating the fourth-order talisman, looking as pale as golden paper and extremely weak.
Chen Mobai immediately reached out to pull him inside the protection of the Six Yang Divine Fire Mirror.
“Just hold on for half a minute more, Shenyu Xuanzhu is down to his last breath!”

The words of the Narcissus sage suddenly rang in their ears, and at this moment, the master of Flower Bloom Courtyard also stood up, drenched in blood, from the cracks at the base of the treasure tree.
She had briefly activated some of her past life’s power, thinking that taking down three Gold Cores would be as easy as reaching out her hand.

But, to her surprise, she had been breached in her defenses by Gongsun Jielu’s Sword Sha and Lan Haitian’s fourth-order talisman one after another. If it weren’t for the critical moment when she called upon Biyu Wutong, she might have been severely injured if not killed under the aurora starfall.
However, she had managed to hold on!
Feeling the spatial rift growing larger and her connection to the Biyu Wutong in the Danxia Mountain Range getting closer, a look of joy couldn’t help but emerge on the corners of her mouth.
If only she could merge with the Biyu Wutong, even facing the Narcissus sage, she would have the strength to fight.
“I hope Shenyu Xuanzhu can use that transformation to buy me another half a minute!”
After communicating with the Biyu Wutong, the master of Flower Bloom Courtyard intended to first blow up the fire vein of Danxia Mountain, which would completely break through the Beiming Domain.

And once the fire vein of Danxia Mountain was blasted open, the spiritual energy supplied to this blessed earth city would gradually weaken, leading to a falling in the grade of the spirit vein, and even possibly initiating tectonic shifts and causing a major earthquake!
Even the Biyu Wutong would degrade in grade over a long period due to insufficient spiritual energy.
But for the master of Flower Bloom Courtyard, that was no longer important.

Because once she got out, she would immediately perform a forbidden technique, exploiting the explosive release of spiritual energy from the blasted spirit vein to forcibly catalyze the progression of the Biyu Wutong.
Afterward, the entire Spirit Vein of Danxia City along with this fourth grade superior spirit plant would transform into a rank-5 nine-colored immortal flower, ready for her to harvest!

chapters.title: Chapter 987 - 987 542
paragraphs: “Just one more step!”
As Master Huakai was thinking this, the Beiming Domain suddenly started to shake.
The void crack she had just barely connected to through the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree was also starting to close suddenly.
“Damn, that beast still has strength left!”

Seeing this scene, Master Huakai’s complexion changed drastically, and she was about to use a forbidden technique to control the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree and blast open the fire veins of Danxia Mountain.
But the crack in the Beiming Domain that she had managed to open was quickly closed under the overwhelming spiritual power of the Narcissus.

“[I have severed Master Huakai’s link to the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree again, and the time it might take to deal with the Divine Control Pavilion Master could be extended by another minute. Can you hold on?]”
The words of Narcissus rang in the ears of Chen Mobai and the others. But by this point, no matter if they were able to hold on or not, they had no choice but to!
“I’ll try my best.”
While Lan Haitian was speaking, he also took out a snow-white elixir and swallowed it. Then, after a few breaths with his eyes closed, the previously pallid color of his complexion suddenly improved.
Such tiger wolf medicine would only be carried by members of their Sky-Mending Group within the Immortal Gate.
“Another attempt is needed. This time, we absolutely cannot be disturbed by these people.”
By this time, Master Huakai too had realized what was happening. Her eyes coldly fixed on Chen Mobai and Lan Haitian.
Gongsun Jielu was still trapped and was no longer a consideration.

If she could suppress or kill the remaining two, then she would be able to wholeheartedly summon the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree and, perhaps, break through the Beiming Domain before Narcissus dealt with the Divine Control Pavilion Master.
At this point, that was the only path left.
Master Huakai no longer hesitated. Her hands performed a seal, and the multicolored treasure tree enveloped her once again.
Although the treasure tree had been damaged due to the consecutive attacks from Gongsun Jielu and Lan Haitian, the two of them were now unable to use the same powerful Sword Sha and talisman.
Master Huakai was confident that with her own cultivation level of a true body of a lifetime and the damaged treasure tree, she could slay Chen Mobai and Lan Haitian.
The treasure tree was now unable to completely envelop her after being damaged, but with the supply of her vital essence, Master Huakai could still use the forbidden technique she had just displayed.
As fresh flowers started blooming on the withered branches again, Lan Haitian’s expression shifted slightly.
He took a deep breath, supporting the Star Concentrating Stone, ready to use the Domain to buy some time.
A dazzling, eye-piercing purple radiance suddenly shone brightly around him!
Chen Mobai’s right hand held the Purple Electric Sword, the flickering electric light like stars, radiating arcs of light constantly from him as the center.

As his hand wielding the sword lifted, the specks of electric light, like fluorescent light, merged into the blade of the Purple Electric Sword. When the blade was raised above his head, a terrifying energy that made the void tremble and the oceans roar with a tsunami-like force had been fully gathered.
“This sword!?”
At this moment, Master Huakai finally noticed the scene.

The news of Chen Mobai wielding the Purple Electric Sword had occupied headlines in the Immortal Gate for quite some time, and although she had been in seclusion nurturing the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree, she was aware of this.
But like Lan Haitian and the others, she had thought that Chen Mobai, even though he was a prodigy, couldn’t possibly make a Rank-4 superior Crystal Divine Sword submit to him.

Rank-4 corresponding to the Yuan Ying level, if it weren’t for the fact that her own treasure tree had been cultivated by her in a previous life, she would probably not be able to control it perfectly, even with treasure-refining techniques.
However, what she was witnessing now, the scene of man and sword achieving one with a Clear Heart of Sword, was beyond Master Huakai’s imagination!
“I’ve misjudged, this guy’s talent is even more terrifying than the legends!”
Master Huakai could say that she had watched Chen Mobai grow step by step to this level, after all, he was a citizen under her command.
When Chen Mobai impressed everyone and won first place during the entrance examination, out of curiosity, she left her body with Divine Consciousness Leaving Body and personally came to observe.
She could affirm that this was a student with very ordinary talent.
It was just his aptitude in Magic Duel that was indeed brilliantly exceptional.
If he had lived in a war-torn era, he would have certainly achieved great things.
But in the peaceful times of the Immortal Gate, being able to enter one of the Ten Great Academies was already quite impressive.

Although eventually, because of Yu Tianguang, Chen Mobai joined the Dance Tool Dao Academy, Master Huakai still did not pay much attention since, essentially, she was at the same level as Master Chengxuan. The Daoist Academy might have a high reputation, but to her, it was just that.
Out of the students who came out of the Daoist Academy, those who could achieve Core Formation were few, and those who could reach Nascent Soul Formation were even fewer.
At least, she hadn’t seen anyone from the Dance Tool Dao Academy’s Gold Core ranks with much hope or potential for Nascent Soul Formation.
At the close of the entrance examination, Master Huakai thought that with Chen Mobai’s talent, Foundation Establishment should be fine, but Core Formation would be hard.
Even if he luckily achieved Core Formation, it would be his final step, never advancing further, never becoming her peer.
Yet, the subsequent developments in Chen Mobai’s journey kept surpassing all her expectations.
Hearing the Path Foundation Establishment, he suppressed all the Foundation Establishment prodigies of the Immortal Gate single-handedly at Jumang Academy!
He even managed to outweigh three Golden Core Masters as just a Foundation Establishment cultivator in the Mountain and Sea Academy, and the Purple Electric Sword favored him.
Such swordsmanship talent made even Master Huakai feel threatened.
But within the territory of the Immortal Gate and with the attention Chen Mobai was receiving, she could only watch quietly, not daring to make a move.
After all, exposing herself for the sake of merely an Immortal Gate prodigy would be unwise.

chapters.title: Chapter 988 - 988 542
paragraphs: There was another reason, after all, that Chen Mobai became silent after his graduation. Whether it was studying at the Repairing Heaven Institute or returning to Red Sandstone City to research farming and talismans, the talent he displayed was only of an upper-middle level.

Subsequently, Master Huakai confidently entered secluded cultivation in preparation for the advancement of the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree. However, when she emerged, she was shocked by the news she heard.
Chen Mobai had comprehended the path and formed his golden core!
What furrowed her brows even more was that after forming his core, he had unexpectedly chosen neighboring Yu Wood City!
At this time, Master Huakai had already sensed some ominous signs.
So when Yu Tianguang was apprehended by the Immortal Gate, she remained unmoved, allowing Lan Haitian and his companions to take the man away.
Regrettably, she had still underestimated the Immortal Gate’s resolve.
And even more, she had underestimated that fellow’s talent!

Watching the dark purple, fan-shaped sword radiance slashing down from the sky, Master Huakai gritted her teeth and fed it another drop of her own essence blood, which wasn’t much to begin with, and stimulated the mighty power of the sacred tree.
The dark purple sword radiance collided with the sea of flowers, erupting into a thunderous roar that shook heaven and earth!
Petals shattered one by one, yet inch by inch they whittled down the power of the Purple Lightning Sword!

“Although this guy can achieve unity of man and sword, he has only just formed his core. The power of the Purple Lightning Sword he can wield is less than one-tenth, maybe even weaker than the Aurora Starfall Talisman!”

After laboriously erasing the last wisp of the Purple Lightning Sword’s thunderous light, Master Huakai’s eyes flickered with a cold gleam, and petals fell one after another, transforming into several flower clones!
“In one fell swoop, turn those two into cocoons as well, make them nutrients for the sacred tree. That way, the connection with the Azure Jadeite Sycamore can be sped up...”
Countless pitch-black Flying Needles shot down from the sky, piercing the six flower clones full of holes.

Lan Haitian utilized his Six Dominions Scripture. Once the Star Concentrating Stone had absorbed enough spiritual power, it resembled a black sun emerging mid-air, continually extracting specially crafted Flying Needles from within the domain using the resources of the Immortal Gate. He formed an impenetrable Yuan Magnet Domain array, launching piercing assaults from all directions toward Master Huakai, merged as one with the sacred tree.
But Master Huakai simply sneered and waved the branches of the sacred tree, instantly brightening tens of thousands of differently colored petals to block every Flying Needle.
This precise control of divine sense showcased Master Huakai’s superior essence.

“Indeed worthy of being a powerhouse of the Evil Path. As things stand, I can only take a risk. I can probably draw her attention for half a minute. Go try to release Vice Minister Gongsun from the flower cocoon seal. If she can act, the three of us should be able to hold out until the arrival of Narcissus Elder!”

As Lan Haitian spoke, a withered yellow branch shot out from the palm of a green flower clone far away, exploiting the gap when he was channeling spiritual power, and pierced through his Yuan Magnet Domain.
If it weren’t for the Yuan Magnetic Force moving Lan Haitian’s body half a step at the crucial moment, he would have likely been impaled through the heart.
Even so, Lan Haitian still ended up with a hole in his side from the branch.
After spitting out a mouthful of blood, he gritted his teeth, took out a black flying knife, and cut off the branch in his side.
“Why aren’t you going...”

After doing all this, Lan Haitian realized Chen Mobai hadn’t moved an inch and became extremely anxious, thinking that his lack of experience in magic duels had left him petrified by the gruesome battle!
Boom!
But just then, a thunderous rumble, which had sounded earlier, once again spread to his ears, and the dim Purple Lightning Sword blade lit up with a stunning brilliance once more.

“Sorry, I was fully preparing for the second sword just now, so I couldn’t divert my attention to respond to you,” said Chen Mobai’s calm voice in Lan Haitian’s ear. He raised his right hand, once again aiming the Purple Lightning Sword at Master Huakai, and brought it down heavily.

The observant Lan Haitian even noticed that the tips of Chen Mobai’s fingers, holding the sword in his right hand, lit up with the colors of the Five Elements, seemingly forming a powerful array that perfectly synchronized with the sword radiance of the Purple Lightning Sword.

The sky lit up with a crescent of dark purple light, which, wherever it passed, turned all the flower clones derived from the sacred tree into a shower of wooden chips and shattered petals without any resistance!

Master Huakai’s face changed dramatically as she threw the Stone Flower Artifact she had refined in her lifetime towards the arc of the Purple Lightning Sword, hoping to detonate the artifact and vent the energy of the sword strike in advance.

But her plan was seen through by Lan Haitian, who had been closely watching the battlefield. He immediately used the Yuan Magnetic Force to move the Star Concentrating Stone along with the remaining thousand or so Flying Needles around the Purple Lightning Sword, hitting the Stone Flower beforehand.
In the midst of the roaring thunder, Lan Haitian’s face suddenly turned pale, and fresh blood spilled from the corner of his mouth.
This meant his Lifespan Artifact was severely damaged and could even be destroyed!
But his action allowed Chen Mobai’s arc of Purple Lightning Sword light to slash unimpeded onto the sacred tree.
Amid the harsh grating noise, the Purple Electric Sword deeply sliced into the deepest part of the treasure tree.
On the left side of Master Huakai’s shoulder, waist, and legs, a deep sword mark that reached the bone became visible, with fresh blood spraying out incessantly.
Amid violent coughing!
Master Huakai clasped his hands in a seal, resorting to a forbidden technique that he had thought he would never use again!
At this moment, high above in the sky, a dark purple arc of light once again lit up!
Chen Mobai’s face was pale, but he held the Purple Electric Sword with a resolute expression, slashing down the third sword strike of the day!
Master Huakai’s eyes widened, staring fixedly at the handsome young man in the sky who was swinging the sword down, as if to etch his visage deeply in his memory.
Following that, the dark-purple fan-shaped arc of light descended, and along the sword mark that had already split the treasure tree, it cut Master Huakai into two.
Blood spread all over the sea, and the treasure tree lost its brilliance entirely.
A withered and broken Stone Flower also fell from mid-air, landing right on the top of Master Huakai’s head, whose eyes were still wide open in death.
“Is it over?”
Lan Haitian asked with some disbelief.
He had thought that this time things looked grim and that they might lose one or two.
To his surprise, Chen Mobai had made three successive strikes, slicing the illustrious Master Huakai of the Ascension Sect down!
“The power of my single sword strike might not match your Aurora Starfall Talisman, but it also possesses Rank-4 might. With three strikes, I think he should be dead!”
Chen Mobai was also unsure, as his opponent was no minor character.
Moreover, he had few experiences using the Purple Electric Sword to kill Golden Core Masters. Those powers from the Ancient Evil Path Union might have some deception or escape techniques!
“You burn her with true fire,” said Lan Haitian hesitantly to Chen Mobai.
Chen Mobai immediately took out the Six Yang Divine Fire Mirror and activated the Pure Yang Fire, directing it onto both halves of Master Huakai’s corpse and the treasure tree.
However, this Pure Yang Fire was too balanced and peaceful and couldn’t ignite the corpse and the treasure tree.
“Chen brother, have you not cultivated the ‘Great Sun Qianyang Fire’ from the Pure Yang Scroll?” asked Lan Haitian, somewhat surprised seeing this.

“I’ve only formed my core recently; when would I have had the time?” replied Chen Mobai truthfully. The Pure Yang Scroll’s core formation section contained many spells, and the Great Sun Qianyang Fire was a signature of the Pure Yang cultivators from the Immortal Gate, one of the six great precious flames. It’s created by combining Pure Yang Fire, Great Sun Fire, and one’s own pill fire. When cultivated to the extreme, even the void could be burned to nothingness.
However, he was always uninterested in techniques that couldn’t rely on resources for cultivation.
“Hey, you kid did quite well, didn’t you?”

Just at that moment, the void opened, and the Jade Narcissus, with her white hair, white eyebrows, and skin like jade, walked in. Seeing Master Huakai’s body with eyes wide open in death upon the ocean, she looked at Chen Mobai with some surprise.
With her realm, she could instantly see the Purple Lightning Sword Power lingering on Master Huakai’s corpse.

“Deputy Division Chief Gongsun and Deputy Head Lan first depleted most of her spiritual power and essence blood, which allowed me the chance to strike her down. I dare not take all the credit,” Chen Mobai said humbly.
The Jade Narcissus listened and then sized him up again, nodding her head in satisfaction.
Afterward, she snapped her fingers, and amidst the whirling of heaven and earth, they had left the Beiming Domain and returned to the Danxia Mountain Range.
“I gave you some face, and left him a breath of life,” the Jade Narcissus pointed toward Yu Tianguang, who was unconscious and trapped within a huge water sphere.
“Thank you, Elder!”
Upon seeing this, Chen Mobai couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.

chapters.title: Chapter 989 - 989 543 The Secret of Flower Bloom Courtyard
paragraphs: “It won’t be easy to save his life, I’m afraid.”
As Narcissus Superior spoke, she also brought out Gongsun Jielu, who had been sealed by Master Huakai within the Beiming Domain.
“Master Yu has shown me kindness, and after all, he is a senior teacher on the roster of Dance Tool Dao Academy. I must do my best.”

If it were anyone else, given Yu Tianguang’s confirmed status as a host body for the Divine Control Pavilion Master’s God Seed, they’d surely be quick to disassociate themselves and prove their innocence.
But Chen Mobai had no such concerns, for he had slain Master Huakai.
This was sufficient to prove his loyalty to the Immortal Sect.
And it was for this reason that he spoke with a clear conscience.
“You’re a loyal and righteous young fellow. Then, I shall give you a hand.”

With each look at Chen Mobai, Narcissus Superior grew more fond of him, feeling that his values and principles perfectly aligned with hers. Moreover, his cultivation level wasn’t weak, and he might very well reach her own rank in the future. Thinking of her own endeavors, she couldn’t help but owe another favor to Chen Mobai.
She took out her phone and dialed a number.
[Hello!]
After the call connected and, since Narcissus Superior had turned on the speakerphone, Chen Mobai heard a familiar voice.
It was the principal of their Dance Tool Dao Academy, Master Chengxuan.

Narcissus Superior: [The matter here is settled, Shi Qing was slain by your academy’s youngster, but Yu Tianguang is also a host for the Divine Control Pavilion Master. In consideration of your face, I left him a breath of life.]
Master Chengxuan remained silent for a moment, seemingly weighing whether it was better for Yu Tianguang to be dead or alive. After a long while, he simply said two words: [Thank you.]

Narcissus Superior: [Gongsun was deceived by Master Huakai. To avoid any hidden dangers, I plan to take her to see Sanjue. Should I take Yu Tianguang as well? His essence, Qi, and spirit have been drained by the Divine Control Pavilion Master and he likely won’t survive more than half a year without prompt treatment.]
Master Chengxuan: [Then I will have to trouble you with this matter, and I’ll give Sanjue a heads-up in advance.]
After a brief conversation, the two of them had settled the matter.
The task of saving Yu Tianguang was essentially handled by Master Chengxuan, thereby extricating Chen Mobai from the situation.
Chen Mobai was quite pleased with this outcome.
After all, if he were to run for the position of one of The Three Great Halls’ Hall Masters in the future, the issue of Yu Tianguang could potentially become a problem.
“Many thanks to you, Superior.”
Chen Mobai expressed his gratitude to Narcissus Superior with a bow.
“Leave this place to you. I must be on my way.”
After applying a seal to the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree, Narcissus Superior left with the sealed Gongsun Jielu and Yu Tianguang.

Although Chen Mobai was a member of the Kaiyuan Hall committee, he only nominally had control over the Immortal Sect branches in Yu Wood City. Plus, he had no experience dealing with the aftermath of events within the Immortal Sect and was completely clueless.
So in the end, it was Lan Haitian who took up the task without complaint.

Since Shi Qing was a member of the Ascension Sect, the personnel within Danxia City’s Immortal Sect system were no longer trusted. After Lan Haitian received authorization from Narcissus Superior, he immediately called upon the Department of Law Enforcement from Wangwu Cave Heaven.

Having presided over the Cinnabarite Institute for over two hundred years, the number of Immortal Sect Disciples who graduated under Shi Qing were countless, and they were nearly ubiquitous across every department of Danxia City. Many even reached out to nearby Blessed Earth Cities and even within certain Cave Heavens.

For instance, Wu Shangru, the former legal representative of the Flying Talisman Factory, who had completed his Foundation Establishment at Cinnabarite Institute before striving and succeeding in moving his household registration into Huayang Cave Heaven.

However, once Shi Qing was exposed, Wu Shangru immediately received a notice from the Immortal Sect instructing him to report to Huayang Cave Heaven’s local Department of Law Enforcement to assist in the investigation.
Besides him, every student who graduated during Shi Qing’s tenure as principal of Cinnabarite Institute was added to the Immortal Sect’s watchlist.
For the foreseeable future, this group would be under close scrutiny by the various departments of the Immortal Sect.
All these troublesome tasks were single-handedly managed by Lan Haitian.
Chen Mobai, meanwhile, was asked to oversee the Danxia Mountain Range during this time, guarding the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree.
This Spirit Plant was temporarily sealed by Narcissus Superior, capable only of absorbing the most basic Spiritual Energy to survive, in order to prevent any outburst due to Master Huakai’s demise.

However, this seal could not last for very long. Given the immense Spiritual Power contained within the fourth grade superior Azure Jadeite Sycamore, which was even greater than Narcissus Superior’s, and the fact that it was closely related to Danxia City’s Fire Vein, a comprehensive sealing plan would require the concerted effort of Immortal Sect’s Forestry Bureau, Land, Formation, and Celestial Phenomenon departments.
Moreover, at minimum, it required the oversight of a proficient Nascent Soul Superior in formations and Spirit Plants.
Yet it seemed that none of the eligible Nascent Soul Superiors were eager to wade into these troubled waters.
So while the upper echelons of The Three Great Halls of the Immortal Sect were still in meetings, Lan Haitian asked Chen Mobai to stand guard until a decision was reached.
Given Chen Mobai’s aversion to getting involved, he naturally wasn’t too happy about it.

But, as he had already become involved, and considering that if Lan Haitian were to request from the upper echelons of the Immortal Sect a Golden Core Master to guard the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree, the Kaiyuan Hall committee would likely give a direct order for the nearest him to undertake the task.

After the battle, Chen Mobai had come to see Lan Haitian as someone he could trust with his life, who had also mentioned that if he was unwilling, he could refuse on the grounds of injury from the encounter with Master Huakai.
But Danxia City was Chen Mobai’s hometown, and at such a turbulent time, he felt it was his duty to step forward and take responsibility.

chapters.title: Chapter 990 - 990 543 The Secret of Flower Bloom Courtyard
paragraphs: _2 Therefore, after making arrangements for Yu Wood City, Chen Mobai calmly and irreversibly took his seat at the highest peak of the Danxia Mountain Range.
During this period, Qin Baipeng, the City Lord of Red Sandstone City, visited several times, hoping to have Chen Mobai save him.

Lan Haitian had already restrained all Immortal Sect institutions in Red Sandstone City, initiating a thorough investigation and screening from top to bottom, with key personnel from several departments taken away for questioning by the Department of Law Enforcement.
As the saying goes, “Weeding out the radishes pulls out the mud.” Before long, Qin Baipeng was also asked to cooperate with the investigation.
Chen Mobai could only assure Qin Baipeng that as long as he had no ties to the Ascension Sect, he would remain unharmed and safe.
After Qin Baipeng, representatives from both Red Dawn Institution and Cinnabarite Institute also sought him out.
“Councilor Chen, many teachers have been taken away for investigation, and many classes have had to stop. The students are all in a panic...”

“The teachers can all take vows of Dao heart, assuring that they have nothing to do with the Ascension Sect. Could Councilor Chen perhaps speak with the Department of Law Enforcement and communicate on our behalf?”
“At the very least, ensure the normal conduct of the students’ classes...”
After hearing the requests from both institutions, Chen Mobai communicated with Lan Haitian, who showed considerable respect. Except for a few key figures, he had the rest of the teachers sent back.
The person in charge of this matter was Lin Yin, and when she came over, there was another matter at hand.
“What is this for?”

Chen Mobai watched curiously as Lin Yin carried transparent glass tubes, in and out of the wooden hut beneath the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree where Shi Qing had long been in seclusion, and couldn’t help but ask.
“These are Spirit Sealing Tubes. They can extract remnants of spiritual power and other energy traces from the air. This way, we can identify who had more contact with Shi Qing.”
Qing Women, a member of the Sky-Mending Group, answered. It was a device they had developed.
In front of Chen Mobai, Lin Yin deployed the device, and soon a stream of blue light formed from the void and flowed into the glass tube in her hand.
Chen Mobai: “Is it really this miraculous?”

Qing Women: “It can only extract traces from the past year; anything earlier has long since dissipated. It’s just a routine procedure, and I doubt Team Leader Lin expects to find any crucial clues with it.”
During this time, Qing Women had been staying by his side. While Chen Mobai presided on the mountain summit, she stayed in the wooden hut on the mountainside.
Although Lan Haitian was short on manpower, he seemed to have forgotten that someone like Qing Women existed within the Sky-Mending Group.
Soon, Lin Yin completed her task.
The energy in all four glass tubes she held was the same blue color.
“This is Shi Qing’s spiritual power, without any further discoveries.”
Lin Yin shook her head in disappointment, although this was an anticipated outcome. As she spoke, she took out a talisman and affixed it to one of the glass tubes.
“What’s this now?”
Chen Mobai asked, pointing to the talisman.

“This is a Spirit Coagulation Talisman. Used in tandem with the Spirit Sealing Tube, it can solidify the extracted spiritual power, preventing it from dissipating. Although Master Huakai has died, her spiritual power holds high research value, and Elder Yuanxu specifically called to have us collect it and send it to him.”
Lin Yin made no attempt to hide anything from Chen Mobai.
After his exceptional performance, Chen Mobai’s level of trust within the upper echelons of the Immortal Sect was no lower than that of Lan Haitian, and he was entitled to be informed of many things.
“Oh, isn’t there a body? Wouldn’t it be more convenient and faster to extract directly from the body?”

Chen Mobai found it somewhat odd to ask; although a cultivator’s spiritual power would slowly dissipate after death, with the technology of the Immortal Sect, they should certainly be able to extract enough.
“Master Huakai’s body was taken by Peach Blossom Sage and given to Three Extremes Sage. Elder Yuanxu is mainly interested in researching the Biyu Wutong.”
Lin Yin didn’t dare say more, only hinting vaguely at Chen Mobai in accordance with Lan Haitian’s intentions.
“I see, are four tubes enough, or should we collect more?”
Unaware of the Nine-Colored Immortal Flower incident, Chen Mobai didn’t understand the hint; instead, he was concerned about the task Elder Yuanxu had assigned.

“That’s enough, the document only required us to collect three tubes, and I’ve already extracted one more. Later, I still need to take a branch from the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree, and I’ll need Councilor Chen’s assistance for that.”

After hearing Lin Yin’s words, Chen Mobai nodded and then used the Immortal Flower’s sealing technique to subdue the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree. He personally took action and cut off a section of the branch with his Purple Electric Sword.
After seeing Lin Yin off, Chen Mobai suddenly thought of something and turned his head to look at the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree standing at the mountain’s peak, pensive.
“What’s the matter?”
Qing Nu, who was by his side, saw his expression and asked curiously.
“The Spirit Sealing Tube and the Spirit Coagulation Talisman, how long can they solidify and preserve the Spiritual Power within?”

Chen Mobai, during his time studying at the Repairing Heaven Institute, had also attended more than a dozen Yuanqi system classes with Yan Bingxuan, and was very familiar with the foundational theories of Elder Yuanxu. He suddenly had an idea that could significantly increase his own combat power in a short time.

“If you are willing to continually use Spirit Coagulation Talismans, theoretically, it could be an unlimited amount of time. The Yuanyang Ancestor’s Pure Yang Qi was preserved in this way,” Qing Nu replied. Although she was from the Sky-Mending Group, she was very familiar with the Spirit Sealing Tube and the Spirit Coagulation Talisman; after all, there were many occasions where their group had to deal with corpses, extracting residual Spiritual Power and such.
Chen Mobai: “Can the Spirit Sealing Tube store any quality of Spiritual Power?”

Qing Nu: “That’s not the case; it depends on the quality of energy you need to store. For instance, explosive thunder or sharp Sword Qi would require specially made, custom-ordered Spirit Sealing Tubes.”
Chen Mobai: “What about flames, like the ‘Great Sun Qianyang Fire’ from our Pure Yang Scroll practitioners?”
Qing Nu: “For that, you would need ceramic pipes made of Spirit Soil, which have good thermal insulation and won’t crack under high temperatures from True Fire.”
Chen Mobai asked some detailed questions, and Qing Nu answered them all.
Soon the sky darkened, and the two said their goodbyes with reluctance.
After Qing Nu left the mountaintop, Chen Mobai had just sat down when he looked up in surprise towards the sky.
Lan Haitian’s figure flew in from a distance, slowly descending.
“Brother Chen, you’ve worked hard during this time.”
“Not at all, I’ve just been staying here. On the other hand, you’ve been the one dealing with the aftermath, which is truly exhausting.”
Chen Mobai felt that Lan Haitian had intentionally waited for Qing Nu to leave before coming over. He invited him to sit down and began to boil water for tea.
“The latest notification from the upper echelons is that Peach Blossom Sage will soon bring people from Jumang Academy and Xianwu Hall to take care of this Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree.”
This news from Lan Haitian was something Chen Mobai had expected.
In the Immortal Sect, the one most renowned for their knowledge about Spirit Plants was none other than the Peach Blossom Sage, who had an advantageous background and natural gifts.
“Then, I suppose I am relieved of my duties.”

Chen Mobai said with a smile. Although sitting here every day, with the Qi of the Fourth-Grade Spirit Vein for cultivation and receiving the highest quality treatment within the Immortal Sect, it still was not as good as Giant Tree Ridge.
Moreover, being tied down here made it difficult to do many things.
“The Department of Portal Management opened Master Huakai’s Domain and discovered various items she had prepared for executing a Forbidden Technique.”
Lan Haitian suddenly shared another piece of news. Chen Mobai picked up the teacup and brewed a cup for him before listening intently.

“We do not yet know the nature of this Forbidden Technique, but it is known to be related to this Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree, and it’s very likely to involve the core inheritance of the Ancient Evil Path Union’s Flower Bloom Courtyard.”

The Flower Bloom Courtyard Head two thousand years ago was the leader of the Ancient Evil Path Union, with a cultivation level and status comparable to today’s Ascension Sect Master. Although records of this lineage in the Immortal Sect were vague, Lan Haitian knew that person was also at the Transformation God Level.
And his accomplishment of Divinity Transformation was partly because he took advantage of the war that opened the portals to Different Worlds, sneaking into one such realm.

Although the Flower Bloom Courtyard Head’s Divinity Transformation was discovered by natives of the Different World due to leaked aura, leading to a siege that he barely escaped from. He then was hunted down by Divinity Transformation cultivators of the Immortal Sect and eventually vanished into oblivion.
However, the secret of his Divinity Transformation has always been pursued by the Upper Echelons of the Immortal Sect.
As Lan Haitian’s words came to this point, Chen Mobai had already understood his implication.

chapters.title: Chapter 991 - 991 544 The Origin of Qing Nu
paragraphs: For the upper echelons of the Immortal Sect, there weren’t many things that could attract their attention anymore.
However, the Secret Technique of Divinity Transformation of the Blossom Yard Godmaker was undoubtedly one of them.

If this Biyu Wutong did indeed have something to do with it, then in the eyes of the people at the top of the Immortal Law, the status of this Spirit Plant would probably rise to a level not inferior to that of Rank-5.
Chen Mobai, “Did the Peach Blossom Sage come for this?”
Lan Haitian, “We can’t speculate about the Sage’s thoughts; we just need to cooperate with her actions.”
Upon hearing this, Chen Mobai nodded; the sooner this matter was resolved, the better for him.
That way, Red Sandstone City could return to peace, and he could continue keeping a low profile in Yu Wood City, focusing on developing and exploring the Tianhe Realm.

Chen Mobai, “By the way, I have always heard that the Ancient Evil Path Union has the theory of the Soldier Rebirth Technique. What is the principle behind this? Why was Master Huakai able to reincarnate as Shi Qing?”

This was a question Chen Mobai had been curious about for a long time, but he had been unable to find any information related to the Forbidden Techniques of the Ancient Evil Path Union within the Immortal Sect. Encountering the example of Master Huakai presented a good opportunity to consult an expert.

Lan Haitian, “The so-called Soldier Rebirth Technique involves destroying one’s original body, allowing the soul and Divine Sense to leave the body, free from physical constraints. Then, find a prepared pregnant woman in advance, and enter into her embryo, thus living anew.”

Chen Mobai was taken aback after hearing this, “In that case, couldn’t the powerful beings of the Ancient Evil Path Union just use this Soldier Rebirth Technique to live eternally in the mortal world?”

“It’s not like that; the Soldier Rebirth Technique has many restrictions, and one can’t escape the cycles of heaven and earth.” Lan Haitian shook his head and began to explain in detail to Chen Mobai.

“A person’s lifespan depends on two factors: spirit and flesh. Although the body can return to its peak through reincarnation, the soul and Divine Sense can’t escape the innate limitations of lifespan and fate.”

“For example, Master Huakai lived for a thousand years, but at five hundred years old, she was caught by the Kaiyuan Hall Master, died with her body destroyed, and reincarnated as Shi Qing through the Soldier Rebirth Technique. But in this life, her lifespan is at most five hundred years.”
“When that time comes, even if Master Huakai’s body is still at its peak, her soul will have to enter the cycle of reincarnation due to reaching the limit of its lifespan.”

“This Soldier Rebirth Technique was originally just a technique of the Antiquity Daoist System for avoiding disaster when the Taoist Body collapsed. Over time, some discovered it could be used to reshape an originally imperfect foundation and began to gain widespread popularity.”
After listening to Lan Haitian’s detailed introduction to the Soldier Rebirth Technique, Chen Mobai showed a look of sudden realization.
So there were so many restrictions.

He thought that if one could reincarnate indefinitely, then those in the Immortal Sect who had cultivated to the Nascent Soul Realm over the past six thousand years and kept reincarnating, there would probably be at least a hundred Nascent Souls by now.
Let alone those at the Spirit Transformation Stage.
In that case, the resources of ten Di Yuan Stars would probably not suffice.
“Then, in the Immortal Sect, how often is this Soldier Rebirth Technique used?”
Chen Mobai hesitated but still asked this question.
Although the Soldier Rebirth Technique had many restrictions, it still represented a chance for cultivators with aging and decaying bodies.
After all, the probability of breakthroughs when the vitality and essence of the body are at their peak is much higher than when aged.

If Nascent Soul Cultivators reincarnate and can inherit the legacy of their past life, they are likely to quickly return to their original realm and even make up for the flaws in their previous foundation to attack the Spirit Transformation Stage, the success rate would definitely be higher.
“I can only say that it exists, but it’s not common.”
Chen Mobai had saved Lan Haitian’s life, so the latter was willing to share what he knew in response to his questions.

“After the Immortal Sect annihilated most of the Ancient Evil Path Union, they also obtained the complete Soldier Rebirth Technique. After detailed research, it was discovered that if one reincarnates into an embryo that has not yet formed, there would be the enigma of the embryo; but such a second-life body would have no barriers and could perfectly integrate with the soul and Spiritual Sense.”

“To avoid the enigma of the embryo, one would have to enter an already formed infant within the mother’s womb, but doing so is equivalent to stopping the birth of a new baby. Besides having the force of bad karma, there is a high probability of disharmony between the Spiritual Sense and the body.”

“The Immortal Sect forbids taking over infants through direct transmigration but allows reincarnation into an embryo. Many superiors who died in wars were given permission to reincarnate through the Soldier Rebirth Technique.”
“Among these, many superiors failed to break free from the enigma of the embryo, but with the guidance of the Immortal Sect, they could live safely to the end of their remaining lifespan.”

“Of course, there are also a few extraordinary individuals who, after reincarnation, ascend to an even higher level of talent and comprehension. Even without awakening their past life memories, they cultivate to a higher realm than their past life.”
Chen Mobai was astonished after hearing Lan Haitian’s words.
This Soldier Rebirth Technique could only be performed by Nascent Soul Superiors, and above the Nascent Soul, there was only the level of Divinity Transformation.
“Who is the illustrious elder?”
He was very curious and could not help but ask.
“It’s the Taiyuan True Monarch. But even with such an example, only in desperate situations would the upper echelons of the Immortal Sect choose the Soldier Rebirth Technique.”

chapters.title: Chapter 992 - 992 544 Qing Nus Origin
paragraphs: Chen Mobai also understood this principle very well.
After all, under the restrictions of the Immortal Sect, the mystery of the rebirth might very well hinder their achievements in their second life.

Even if they had the support of family, old friends, and disciples, if they started cultivating from scratch without their memories, whether they could achieve the Nascent Soul Realm for a second time was uncertain.
Moreover, acquiring resources for “Nascent Soul Formation” within the Immortal Sect was extremely difficult.
“Thank you, Brother Lan, for resolving my doubts.”
By now, Chen Mobai had understood all about the Soldier Rebirth Technique, and he couldn’t help but thank Lan Haitian.
“If you were to join the Hall of Orthodox Law, this information would be open to you as well.”
Lan Haitian, however, said something that took Chen Mobai by surprise.
“The Hall of Orthodox Law shouldn’t be short of people. Why is Brother Lan also recruiting?”
First it was Gongsun Jielu, and now Lan Haitian—Chen Mobai truly did not feel he was that popular.

“We’re not lacking in mediocre personnel, but we are short of a combat genius like Brother Chen. Although Yu Tianguang’s body is possessed by the Divine Control Pavilion Master, the Battle Law Victory evaluation he gave you was indeed well-deserved,” Lan Haitian candidly said. As the institution of the Immortal Sect in charge of its two great forces of violence, the Hall of Orthodox Law should, in theory, recruit all of the sect’s combat geniuses.
About Chen Mobai, Lan Haitian had taken notice of him during the admission trials in Red Sandstone City.
After he had completed his “Taoist pill formation,” this information was submitted to Gongsun Jielu and the Nascent Soul Superior entitled Narcissus.
And after slaying Master Huakai, Chen Mobai’s personal profile was upgraded again and had personally been inquired upon by the Righteous Law Hall Master.
The Righteous Law Hall Master said a lot after reading it.
His subordinates condensed it, turning it into a phrase that was passed on to Lan Haitian.
Why is such an impressive combat genius not in the Hall of Orthodox Law?
So Lan Haitian came.
“I still prefer the quiet.”
Chen Mobai naturally declined politely.

“With Brother Chen’s talent, if you were to join our Hall of Orthodox Law and become the Vice Hall Master, obtaining the baby-forming spiritual things would definitely not be a problem. Why not give it some serious thought?”
Lan Haitian made one last effort.

“The Immortal Sect is a place that ranks people by seniority. The current Vice Hall Master, Nascent Soul Superior Narcissus has already achieved Nascent Soul Formation, but behind him, Gongsun Jielu and the overall leader of your Patching Heaven Group are queueing up. After these two obtain the Baby-forming Spiritual Things, I might have to compete with you. That would be too draining on my heart and mind, and too time-consuming. It’s not what I desire,” Chen Mobai gave a reason. After hearing this, Lan Haitian’s eyes reflected an indescribable emotion.
“I’m very grateful that Brother Chen does not wish to compete with me,” Lan Haitian said.
After his “Taoist pill formation,” Lan Haitian naturally also harbored ambitions for the Hall’s resources for Nascent Soul Formation.
Though he had always been modest, deep down there was an arrogance that made him feel supreme over everything in the Immortal Sect.
He believed no one within the sect was his competitor in this regard.
But having witnessed Chen Mobai slaying Master Huakai with three sword strokes, he knew that now he had a rival.
If Chen Mobai truly had the intention to join the Hall of Orthodox Law, then a hundred years later, they might indeed engage in an intense competition for the Nascent Soul spiritual resources.
But the invitation was the intention of the Righteous Law Hall Master, personally conveyed by the Sky-Mending Group overall leader—it was an order Lan Haitian could not refuse to carry out.
Fortunately, Chen Mobai did not waver and still had no intention of coming out of seclusion.
This made Lan Haitian feel both relieved and very grateful.
“Brother Lan, you also supported me quite a bit during my Foundation Establishment phase, no need to be so formal,” Chen Mobai said.
Whether it was the matter of Little Red Sky, or answering Chen Mobai’s questions after his own “Taoist pill formation,” Chen Mobai had not forgotten any of it.
“Since that’s the case, Brother Chen, there is another matter I need to inform you about. I hope you are mentally prepared.”

At that moment, Lan Haitian suddenly spoke with a somber expression, causing Chen Mobai’s own expression to become serious as well. Chen Mobai thought Lan Haitian was going to announce a major purging of those related to the Ascension Sect that had been captured during the cleansing of Red Sandstone City.
Lan Haitian, “How much do you know about the matter of Qing Nu?”
Chen Mobai, “Huh!”

Chen Mobai hadn’t expected Lan Haitian to bring up this topic. Only then did he realize that although Lan Haitian had arrived earlier, he had waited until after Qing Nu left before coming out of hiding.
Was this the important issue he had come to discuss today?
Chen Mobai, “I only know she looks exactly like Master Xin Ji’s daughter, and the mastermind behind the scenes must be some prominent figure in the upper echelons of the Immortal Sect.”
After hearing this, Lan Haitian nodded slightly. He even expanded his own domain to preclude anyone else from overhearing his next words.

Lan Haitian, “The experiment that took place over forty years in Yu Wood City was called the ‘Immortal Sprout Cultivation and Adjustment Plan’. Its official purpose was to assist those cultivators in the Immortal Sect who had lost or damaged their bodies due to cultivation accidents.”
Immortal Sprout Cultivation and Adjustment Plan!
Chen Mobai was puzzled upon hearing this. What did this have to do with Qing Nu and the others?

Lan Haitian, “Using bionic genetic technology, artificers could fabricate the limbs or certain organs that cultivators needed to replace their own deficient parts. Initially, this was designed for medical purposes. But underneath the surface of this plan, Master Xin Ji was actually attempting to fully clone and adjust a human being in order to revive his own daughter.”

Lan Haitian, “Those who supported Master Xin Ji from the upper echelons of the Immortal Sect aimed to create a reincarnated body that would avoid the secrets of the embryo, circumvent karmic forces, and sidestep Immortal Sect laws during the Soldier Rebirth Technique.”

Lan Haitian, “Moreover, these artificially adjusted human embryos could be an attempt to edit the talent of a Spiritual Root at the genetic level. If we could ensure that the reincarnated body possessed a Heavenly Spiritual Root, then, without the secrets of the embryo and with the essence of a Nascent Soul Superior plus the resources of the Immortal Sect, it is estimated they could return to their original realm within sixty years.”
Upon hearing this, Chen Mobai’s face underwent drastic changes.

He finally understood why the laboratory contained the likes of Qing Nu with a Heavenly Spiritual Root and even other rare Different Spiritual Roots such as Wind Spiritual Root and Dark Spiritual Root.
The original intent of the experiment was to create embryos with extraordinary talents to enable the upper echelons of the Immortal Sect to undergo reincarnation via the Soldier Rebirth Technique.
“Who is it?”
Chen Mobai forced himself to calm down, lifting his head to look at Lan Haitian as he asked coldly.
Without being explicit, Lan Haitian knew what he was asking—the identity of the Immortal Sect higher-ups who were backing the experiment.

“I don’t know that much. I can only access the records of the Immortal Sprout Cultivation and Adjustment Plan up to this point. Beyond that, only the Courtyard Heads of The Three Great Halls or a Vice Hall Master would have the authority.”
Lan Haitian shook his head. However, even this statement revealed key information.
The mastermind behind the Immortal Sprout Cultivation and Adjustment Plan must be, at the very least, at the rank of Vice Hall Master of the Immortal Sect.
Or possibly... one of The Three Great Halls Courtyard Heads!
Chen Mobai couldn’t help but recall the scene where he met Kong Feichen in Jumang Academy, saying that their tragic childhoods were caused by The Three Great Halls of Xianmen Courtyard Heads.
Where did he find this information?
Was the Ascension Sect involved, or was there someone from that sect within the upper ranks of the Immortal Sect?
Lan Haitian told Chen Mobai about this because, with his current realm and strength, Chen Mobai was deemed to have the qualification to know about it.
After all, he was deeply backed and considered the future successor of the Dance Tool Dao Academy.

Given that two of The Three Great Halls Courtyard Heads were from the Repairing Heaven Institute, there could be a potential clash with this dominant force in the Immortal Sect when the matter was thoroughly investigated in the future.

Fortunately, though the Dance Tool Dao Academy only had two Nascent Souls, they had an ancestor at the Divinity Transformation stage, Baiguang, who could offer resistance should a conflict with the Repairing Heaven Institute arise.
Upon reflecting on this, Chen Mobai suddenly realized another detail!
Back in the Mountain and Sea Academy, Hao Cao said that he encountered the reincarnated body of Ancestor Baiguang!
Moreover, that body had not yet awakened its own consciousness!
Combining what Lan Haitian had said about the Soldier Rebirth Technique with this new piece of information, Chen Mobai’s eyes widened as he gasped in shock.
“What’s wrong?”
Seeing Chen Mobai’s reaction, Lan Haitian couldn’t help but curiously ask.
“It’s nothing, just a bit shocked after suddenly learning the true nature of the matter!”

chapters.title: Chapter 993 - 993 545 Devour God Technique
paragraphs: After sending Lan Haitian away, Chen Mobai sat alone under the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree, deep in thought.
If Ancestor Baiguang had indeed disassembled and reincarnated, it would mean that the Immortal Sect now had only Leading Star Ancestor as a Divinity Transformation expert!
In that case, wouldn’t their Dance Tool Dao Academy’s most significant backing have vanished, reducing their power to the bottom of the Four Great Daoist Sects?
Fortunately, Chen Mobai could count on the support of the Repairing Heaven Institute.
But if future circumstances arose where the masterminds behind the Immortal Sprout modulation plan were the two Hall Masters of the Repairing Heaven Institute, he would be utterly powerless.
He could only hope that Qing Nu wouldn’t become obsessed over this matter in the future.
As Chen Mobai’s thoughts wandered, he suddenly remembered the girl named Xiao Hei he had met at the Five Peaks Immortal Mountains.
She lived on Ancestor Baiguang’s Wangxian Peak and possessed the very rare Pure Yin Body. Could she be the reincarnation of Ancestor Baiguang?
To arrange for oneself a top-tier Pure Yin Body after reincarnation would be entirely plausible.
Though her age seemed a bit off, if she truly was Ancestor Baiguang, then Xiao Hei’s age could not be judged by her appearance.
The more Chen Mobai thought about it, the more likely it seemed.
However, to know the truth, he would still need to ask Hao Cao or Pei Qingshuang.
Aside from the Nascent Soul Superiors of the immortal sect, those two, teacher and disciple, were likely the most familiar with the matter concerning Ancestor Baiguang’s reincarnation.
But probing into this matter would not be without risk and could even draw the attention of Leading Star Ancestor.
After some contemplation, Chen Mobai felt that a cautious investigation would be better.
Moreover, as his cultivation level rose and his status within the Dance Tool Dao Academy faction grew, he would eventually find out the truth from Master Chengxuan.
He decided to proceed step by step, first focusing on his cultivation and enhancing his realm.

Chen Mobai ultimately opted for a steady approach, for he was already on the Broad Avenue of cultivation. With the resources of the Tianhe Realm, reaching Golden Core Perfection was a certainty, so there was no need to draw undue attention from the upper echelons of the Immortal Sect over this matter.
Additionally, Chen Mobai harbored another speculation in his heart.
He wondered if the mastermind behind the Immortal Sprout modulation plan in Yu Wood City was Ancestor Baiguang.

After all, he knew that Yu Huiping, a disciple of Ancestor Baiguang, was a descendant of Yu Zi, the first City Lord of Yu Wood City. Ancestor Baiguang was also a descendant of this lineage, having moved to Red City Cave Heaven with his parents when he was young.
If Ancestor Baiguang was the mastermind, it would explain why the Immortal Sect was so wary of Mo Shen.
That would be the worst-case scenario.
Pondering this, Chen Mobai felt an increased sense of pity for Qing Nu.

If things were as he suspected, even if she fulfilled all her potential as a Heavenly Spiritual Root, she might only be able to continue her existence in the Immortal Sect by forgetting her tragic childhood.
In that case, it would be better for Qing Nu to defect to the Ascension Sect with Kong Feichen.
For some reason, this thought surfaced in Chen Mobai’s mind.
If such a situation did arise, what would he do?
After some reflection, Chen Mobai could only shake his head and wryly smile.
Although he was close friends with Qing Nu, he could not abandon his parents, relatives, friends, and mentors in the Immortal Sect for her sake.
If Qing Nu left the Immortal Sect, he could only offer his understanding and bid her farewell.
He just hoped that day would never come.
Because if Qing Nu truly joined the Ascension Sect, that would mean they were on opposing sides.
Amidst his tumultuous thoughts, Chen Mobai involuntarily sat down to meditate and cultivate the Nourishing Thought Forge God Technique, hoping to dispel the clutter in his mind.
As his cultivation level grew higher, his emotions seldom fluctuated.

He practiced the Nourishing Thought Forge God Technique because he remembered that it was through its contemplation, focusing on the Azure Jadeite Sycamore, that he had established the foundation of his Divine Sense.

Having witnessed Yu Tianguang’s body used by the Devour God Technique to manifest as the vessel for the descent of the Divine Control Pavilion Master, Chen Mobai felt a mixture of awe and curiosity toward the technique.
While Yu Tianguang was transcribing it, Chen Mobai was nearby, so he memorized the contents of the “Azure Jadeite Charm,” which contained the secrets of the Devour God Technique.
During his time overseeing Danxia Mountain Range, he also downloaded the standard version of the “Azure Jadeite Charm” from the Immortal Gate National Library.

After comparing the two, he found Yu Tianguang’s transcription to be much more profound, with nearly double the content. After eliminating the differences between the two versions, he obtained a scripture of over thirty thousand words.
Is this the Devour God Technique?
With the forbidden technique in his possession, Chen Mobai was naturally curious, but he had always been prudent and would not jeopardize his future by cultivating the Devour God Technique.
However, taking a look wouldn’t be a problem.

Though he didn’t dare to search the internet for related terminology due to the lack of guidance, and his understanding of the technique was somewhat hazy, he at least grasped the general cultivation framework.

The main principle of cultivating the Devour God Technique is encapsulated in two phrases: “the Way of Heaven, reducing the surplus to compensate the insufficient,” and “the Way of Humanity, reducing the insufficient to serve the surplus.”
Among these, the Way of Heaven is the proper method of cultivating the Devour God Technique, while the Way of Humanity is the reason it is considered a forbidden technique by the Immortal Sect.
The so-called Way of Heaven involves seeing oneself as the insufficient part, then drawing from the surplus to enhance one’s Divine Sense.

For example, in the “Azure Jadeite Charm,” Shi Qing or the Divine Control Pavilion Master regarded the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree as the surplus of Heaven, while the human form was the insufficient part.

chapters.title: Chapter 994 - 994 545 Devour God Technique
paragraphs: Therefore, while contemplating the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree, one can construct a bridge between the human body and the tree using the Path of Heaven, allowing the vast but unconscious spiritual sense of this fourth-order spirit plant to surge towards the contemplator, speeding up the enhancement of the meditator’s divine consciousness.
The closer one is to the Azure Jadeite Sycamore, the more rapidly the contemplative cultivator improves.

For the Azure Jadeite Sycamore itself, since it has been stuck at the bottleneck of the fourth grade superior for hundreds of years, the spiritual power it swallows and the divine consciousness it generates are unconsciously scattered between heaven and earth. Hence, meditating on the Azure Jadeite Lucid Strategy will not cause any depletion to the Azure Jadeite Sycamore; instead, it helps nurture the mountains and rivers of Red Sandstone City.
Although Chen Mobai is not sure whether these contents are true, he suspects that this is why Yu Tianguang was deceived and ended up unknowingly cultivating a forbidden technique.

The Devour God Technique hidden within Yu Tianguang’s Azure Jadeite Lucid Strategy is probably detailed in the Path of Heaven’s cultivation content for the sake of disguise, while the Way of Humanity is only briefly mentioned in passing, as a contrast.
If Yu Tianguang had been more cautious and attentive, he might have been able to detect the nuances in those two lines.
Those two lines were added by Shi Qing in her own speculative tone, hypothesizing about the advancement of the Azure Jadeite Lucid Strategy to the Nascent Soul.

She assumed that the sycamore trees sprawling across Danxia Mountain Range, when cut down, could be used for alchemy, artifact refining, talisman making, among other raw materials. However, the pure and unconscious spiritual thought contained within would dissipate between heaven and earth, without perfect utilization.

If these bound-to-be-dissipated spiritual senses of the sycamore trees were to be concentrated within the human body, then over time, accumulating little by little, they would eventually pile up like a sand tower or converge like a deep pool, transforming into a mighty torrent of divine consciousness that breaks through all obstacles and bottlenecks.
This is the Way of Humanity, to sacrifice the insufficient to sustain the surplus.
After reading the Devour God Technique, Chen Mobai couldn’t help but marvel at its profound mystery.

This Way of Humanity was likely the key to how Yu Tianguang became implanted with the God Seed by the master of the Divine Control Pavilion; just like the ubiquitous sycamore trees, ready to be harvested and cut down when needed.

After dispelling the stray thoughts using the Nourishing Thought Forge God Technique, Chen Mobai then activated the Divine Manipulation Technique to cultivate his divine sense until dawn, when he finally slowly opened his eyes.
After getting up, he looked at the giant Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree beside him and couldn’t help but sigh.
Although the foundation of his divine consciousness was forged by contemplating this very Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree,

now, even when he is closest to it and practices the Art of Divine Consciousness, it merely results in a clearer image of the sycamore tree in the sea of his consciousness, with almost no enhancement.
It seems that only the Devour God Technique provides the rapid growth described by Yu Tianguang.
Initially thinking he had found a shortcut to divine consciousness cultivation, Chen Mobai couldn’t help feeling a wave of disappointment after his trials.
Indeed, the path of cultivation can only be taken one step at a time, with the expenditure of resources.

After achieving Core Formation, due to his Fire Spirit Body and Heavenly Fire Spiritual Root, and coupled with the fourth-order superior spiritual qi and spirit stones from Giant Tree Ridge, Chen Mobai’s progress in cultivating spiritual power was almost equivalent to constantly consuming Qi-replenishing Spirit Water.
He felt that in another two years, he would easily break through to the second layer of the Gold Core.
However, in comparison to spiritual power, the progress of his divine consciousness was somewhat inferior.

Although relying on the effects of the Golden Liquid Jade Return Pill, he had progressed to the second layer of the Golden Core, the Divine Manipulation Technique had reached its limit after attaining the Golden Core Realm.
Although it could continue to enhance, achieving an accomplishment in divine consciousness would still require a more suitable Divine Consciousness Technique.
Chen Mobai’s goal was threefold: the Sun Golden Crow Method, the Candle Dragon Xianguang Technique, and the Vermilion Phoenix Facing the Sun Diagram.
Many cultivators cultivate the Pure Yang Scroll among the Immortal Gates, which is the most suitable method honed over thousands of years.
Chen Mobai has always liked to follow the established path, preparing to switch to another Divine Consciousness Technique after reaching Core Formation.
But because the key Coagulating Spirit Incense was not yet available, he had been delaying it.
Now that he had acquired the Devour God Technique, Chen Mobai felt an unusual stir in his emotions for the first time in a while.

Because after reading through it, he was confident that if he cultivated under the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree in the manner of the Path of Heaven as described by the Devour God Technique, he could elevate his divine consciousness to the perfection of the ninth level of the Gold Core within a hundred years.
Fortunately, Chen Mobai was very rational.
After memorizing the gist of the Devour God Technique and comparing it, he turned the paper into ashes.
This version was definitely not suitable for cultivation; however, if there was an opportunity in the Tianhe Realm in the future, he could consider reworking it.
See if he could extract its essence and contemplate the Great Dao Tree within the Divine Tree Secret Realm, drawing its spiritual sense with the Path of Heaven.
After all, the main reason Yu Tianguang was defeated was because he was unknowingly implanted with a God Seed by the Shenyu Xuanzhu using the Way of Humanity at some point.
But with Chen Mobai’s cautious personality, he would definitely want to confirm that there were no problems after changing the main subject of his contemplation before he might attempt it.

However, with his talent and comprehension, if he wanted to revise the Azure Jadeite Lucid Decree, which contains the essence of the Devour God Technique, to focus on the Great Dao Tree and ensure there would be no traces of any Forbidden Technique, he would probably need to drink a lot of Enlightenment Tea.
He could only hope that Zhuo Ming would manage to cultivate the Enlightenment White Tea tree to Rank-3 soon.
At this moment, Chen Mobai realized how precious the tea tree gifted to him by Wen Ren Xuewei was.

To cultivators from Immortal Gate, it might seem like getting whatever cultivation technique they wanted was just a matter of downloading it, so why bother thinking for themselves, but for Chen Mobai, who had personally experienced the effects of Soul Awakening Dao Pills and Enlightenment Tea, these items were extremely useful.
This was especially true for someone like him who needed to disguise himself.

Moreover, Chen Mobai felt that his understanding of the Devour God Technique might just be superficial, and to avoid potential hidden dangers, he still needed to be in a state of enlightenment to fully comprehend it.
At this time, the sunrise began to light up the sky.
The first rays of sunlight filtered through the leaves of the Azure Jadeite Sycamore Tree and fell on Chen Mobai, making him feel as if he had seen the bright path of Dao.
Just then, a graceful figure flew up, her brows and eyes picturesque, her face clear and beautiful, and at the sight of Chen Mobai, a smile appeared on her lips, incomparably beautiful.
“Here.”
Qing Nu came over and, with a look of seeking approval, handed the box she was holding to Chen Mobai.
“Oh, it’s arrived so soon, thank you!”
Chen Mobai knew well what it was and opened it happily.
It was precisely as he had requested: three Spirit Sealing Tubes made to the standards for storing Great Sun Qianyang Fire.

After Qing Nu took note, they were custom ordered from the Sky-Mending Group Team Two, and naturally, Chen Mobai had also given Lan Haitian a heads-up, otherwise it wouldn’t have been completed so quickly.

After all, Sky-Mending Group Team Two was specifically responsible for making various peculiar magic artifact equipment, and their workload was already full. Only after Lan Haitian, the deputy group leader, personally made a call were they able to put Chen Mobai’s order for the Spirit Sealing Tubes on the fast track.
“What are you planning to do with this?”
Seeing Chen Mobai inspect each Spirit Sealing Tube carefully, Qing Nu couldn’t help but ask with curiosity.
“I plan to cultivate a powerful kind of flames.”
Chen Mobai did not hide this from Qing Nu, and upon hearing it, she assumed he meant the Great Sun Qianyang Fire and decided not to inquire further.
Now that he had the Spirit Sealing Tubes in hand, the only thing missing was the Spirit Coagulation Talisman.
Chen Mobai did not call upon his contacts to purchase these as he had been trying to draw them himself during this time.
With his current Golden Core Realm, if he focused on learning a single Talisman Paper, it was quite simple for him to achieve success.
After only a few attempts, he mastered the Rank-1 and Rank-2 Spirit Coagulation Talismans.
Although he kept failing at the Rank-3, he felt progression with each failure.
“Let me help you grind the ink!”
Seeing Chen Mobai bring out the Talisman Brush and ink, Qing Nu stood by his side and, with a gentle wave of her hand, began to help.
“Thank you very much!”

Chen Mobai naturally nodded with a smile. Perhaps it was having a beauty by his side that boosted his motivation and desire to perform, by evening he had successfully completed a Rank-3 Spirit Sealing Talisman.
And with the successful experience in hand, what followed was a natural string of successes.

The closer one is to the Azure Jadeite Sycamore, the more rapidly the contemplative cultivator improves.

For the Azure Jadeite Sycamore itself, since it has been stuck at the bottleneck of the fourth grade superior for hundreds of years, the spiritual power it swallows and the divine consciousness it generates are unconsciously scattered between heaven and earth.
Hence, meditating on the Azure Jadeite Lucid Strategy will not cause any depletion to the Azure Jadeite Sycamore; instead, it helps nurture the mountains and rivers of Red Sandstone City.

If Yu Tianguang had been more cautious and attentive, he might have been able to detect the nuances in those two lines.

If these bound-to-be-dissipated spiritual senses of the sycamore trees were to be concentrated within the human body, then over time, accumulating little by little, they would eventually pile up like a sand tower or converge like a deep pool, transforming into a mighty torrent of divine consciousness that breaks through all obstacles and bottlenecks.
This is the Way of Humanity, to sacrifice the insufficient to sustain the surplus.
